Entries.Title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
Entries.Description: July 1st, 2030. Manga editor Nishino Mizuho is having the worst 27th birthday ever. The manga she’s in charge of will be ending. However, when she sees a group of high school students having fun, she recalls her own adolescence. 10 years ago, during her second year of high school, Mizuho had four childhood friends who she grew up with in a residential neighborhood known as Koigahama Highlands…

Episodes.Title: An Awful Birthday
Episodes.Description: July 1st, 2030. Manga editor Nishino Mizuho is having the worst 27th birthday ever. The manga she’s in charge of will be ending. However, when she sees a group of high school students having fun, she recalls her own adolescence. 10 years ago, during her second year of high school, Mizuho had four childhood friends who she grew up with in a residential neighborhood known as Koigahama Highlands…

Episodes.Title: I'll Be by Your Side
Episodes.Description: Kizuki, who Mizuho saw as the crybaby little brother of the group, has lately been hitting on her. Since Mizuho believed her and Kizuki would be childhood friends forever, she is not sure how to approach this situation. He's on her mind to the point where she seems disoriented, and even says something that could potentially push Kizuki away.

Episodes.Title: Warmth
Episodes.Description: Afraid of ruining their relationship, Mizuho tells herself not to fall for Kizuki. All the stress makes her ill, and her friends come to help.

Episodes.Title: Fireworks for the Future
Episodes.Description: After spending the day at the aquarium, Kizuki asks Mizuho to cheer for him at his swim meet.

Episodes.Title: How to Be Together Forever
Episodes.Description: As the fireworks are set off, Mizuho rushes to look for Kizuki. At the pool she runs into...?

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to Be Just Friends
Episodes.Description: Mizuho is reluctant to visit Kizuki's house for dinner while her dad is away.

Episodes.Title: Playing Nice
Episodes.Description: Shugo's older brother, Togo, makes a surprise return to Koigahama Highlands.

Episodes.Title: The Shape of One-Sided Love
Episodes.Description: Mizuho goes out with Shugo and Togo and strongly contemplates her feelings for Kizuki.

Episodes.Title: The Times I Spent With You
Episodes.Description: Shin steps up as the student council president to ensure the Ao High Festival can be held.

Episodes.Title: Impulse
Episodes.Description: The group goes on a camping trip! Airu tells Shin to be more selfish and he follows his suggestion.

Episodes.Title: Things That Change
Episodes.Description: Mizuho starts becoming aware of Shin's intentions after he kissed her at the campsite.

Episodes.Title: Neverending Dream
Episodes.Description: Shin and Kizuki compete over Mizuho. Meanwhile she finds out the results of the Newcomers' Manga Competition.

Entries.Title: 7 Bears
Entries.Description: Snow White has moved in — and she won't budge until the bears help her reclaim her magic boots. The bears think their brother has transformed into a fly.

Episodes.Title: Snow White and the Seven Bears / The Seven Bears Not Dwarfs
Episodes.Description: Snow White has moved in — and she won't budge until the bears help her reclaim her magic boots. The bears think their brother has transformed into a fly.

Episodes.Title: The Dancing Potion / The Potato Touch
Episodes.Description: The bears use magic to get the Prince grooving at the King's Ball. The Witch grants one bear the power to turn anything — or anyone — into a potato.

Episodes.Title: Stumblebumpskin / The Perfect Toast
Episodes.Description: The bears meet a naughty gnome who challenges them to a butt-kicking contest. A search for the perfect slice of toast puts Snow White in danger.

Episodes.Title: Bearpunzel / Princilocks and the Seven Bears
Episodes.Description: A bear's wish for a big, bouncy butt lands him in a tight spot. The brothers help Prince Charmless win the King's approval with a royal manners makeover.

Episodes.Title: Bearsel & Gretel / Jack & the Bearstalk
Episodes.Description: The bears hear a rumor that makes them worry the Witch wants to eat them. One bear gets the King's attention after eating magic beans.

Episodes.Title: The Big, Bad Favor / Basket Case
Episodes.Description: The bears protect three pigs — and a huge potato stash — from a hungry wolf. Red Riding Hood drags the brothers into her battle with the Big Bad... Jerry?

Episodes.Title: The Pied Butt Scratcher / Princess & the Pea-tato
Episodes.Description: Armed with a magic flute, the bears try to rid the land of itchy butt bugs. A tiny potato hidden under a mattress gives the bears a sleepless night.

Episodes.Title: Bears Vs. Dwarfs / The Bear in the Magic Lamp
Episodes.Description: Snow White helps the Seven Dwarfs take over the bears' mine. While helping kind storyteller Scheherazade, the brothers get sucked into her magic lamp.

Episodes.Title: The Bear Prince / The Ugly Guardling
Episodes.Description: Prince Charming mistakes one of the brothers for his favorite teddy bear. After bumping his head, a bear thinks he's a member of the King's royal guard.

Episodes.Title: Cinderella's Quiceanbeara / Puss' N Bears
Episodes.Description: Fairy asks the bears to host Cinderella's 15th birthday party. Then, Puss in Boots helps the brothers track down the mythical, magical... Crystal Potato!

Episodes.Title: Determination
Episodes.Description: After the sobering realization that Hikaru is truly dangerous, Yoshiki decides that he must act and invites his best friend to skip school together.

Episodes.Title: Contact
Episodes.Description: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

Entries.Title: You and Idol Precure ♪
Entries.Description: Uta Sakura lives in Hanamichi Town. One day while on a walk, she meets a fairy named Purirun. Purirun has come in search of Kirakiland’s savior called Idol Precure.

Episodes.Title: Cure Idol Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Uta Sakura lives in Hanamichi Town. One day while on a walk, she meets a fairy named Purirun. Purirun has come in search of Kirakiland’s savior called Idol Precure.

Episodes.Title: Am I Going Viral?
Episodes.Description: The Queen of Kirakiland, Pikarine, tells Uta about Team Chokkiri and their boss, Darkine. Meanwhile, Cure Idol is going viral on TV and social media as a “mysterious new idol.”

Episodes.Title: Have Courage! Cure Wink Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Nana, who is feeling down about a mistake she made during her piano competition, is invited to Uta’s family’s home, Café Glitter. Uta and Uta’s little sister Hamori cheer her up, and she is ready to do her best at the school welcome event…

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Idol?! Kaito Hibiki
Episodes.Description: Just like it did with Cure Idol, the word is spreading about Cure Wink. Meanwhile, another popular “legendary idol” Kaito Hibiki drops by Cafe Glitter.

Episodes.Title: We Got a Manager!
Episodes.Description: A man named Tanaka appears before Uta and Nana and says he knows they're Idol Precures. Meanwhile, a message arrives that says, “I want to hire the Pretty Cures.”

Episodes.Title: My Heart's Going Kyun-Kyun?!
Episodes.Description: Uta and Nana get to know Kokoro Shigure, president of the Cure Idol and Cure Wink Research Club. Purirun wants to become friends with Kokoro and follows her after school.

Episodes.Title: Dancing Heart! Cure Kyun-Kyun's Debut!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro is shocked to see Cure Idol and Cure Wink battle the Makkuranda, and runs away, saying “I can’t do that!” She tries to forget about the Idol Precures that she loves by putting away all her merchandise and dancing her troubles away, but…

Episodes.Title: Sleepover! Idol Precure Study Session!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro says she wants to study Cure Idol and Cure Wink, so they decide to have a sleepover at Uta’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Wonders of Nana!
Episodes.Description: On their way home from school, Nana suddenly begins acting strangely. When she continues to say and do strange things, Uta and Kokoro start to count the “Seven Wonders of Nana.”

Episodes.Title: CD Debut! Idol Precure!
Episodes.Description: The Idol Precure songs are being made into a CD, so Cure Idol and the others start recording. But Cure Kyun-Kyun is so nervous that she can’t sing well.

Episodes.Title: Trio Dreams
Episodes.Description: Inspired by the school broadcast, Uta and the others begin to think about their dreams for the future. To help Uta, who is having trouble deciding, Nana and Kokoro begin “Uta’s Dream Search Project.”

Episodes.Title: Purirun's fan, Meroron is here!
Episodes.Description: A new arrival to Hanamichi Town from Kirakiland is discovered. Purirun says it’s Meroron, and Uta and her friends go searching for them.

Episodes.Title: Go! Go! Kirakilight!
Episodes.Description: Uta and her friends form a girls volleyball team for the school ball-game tournament. On her team is Wakaba, a member of the official school team. She’s in love with Shota, another volleyball player, and declares that she’ll tell him her feelings if they win.

Episodes.Title: Dear Mom, a Message from Kokoro
Episodes.Description: Kokoro’s mother has to work despite it being the weekend, and Kokoro sees her off. Kokoro buys her a carnation for Mother’s Day and has trouble coming up with a good message for the card, so she drops by Cafe Glitter to get some advice.

Episodes.Title: Operation Make Sissy Fall In Love
Episodes.Description: Meroron is jealous of Purirun’s relationship with Uta, so Uta and the others, who also want to be closer with Meroron, encourage Purirun to spend more time with Meroron. Purirun invites Meroron to dress in matching outfits and go on a date.

Episodes.Title: Full Bloom! Intensive Practice! Hanamichi Town Festival!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure is invited to appear at the Hanamichi Town Festival. Uta and the others want to make the event a success, so they ask Tanaka to help them make an intensive practice regimen.

Episodes.Title: Purirun's Decision! Let's Go to Kirakiland!
Episodes.Description: Purirun desperately wants to help Uta and decides to go to Kirakiland with Meroron. Meanwhile, Uta and the others are preparing to go on stage at the Hanamichi Town Festival.

Episodes.Title: Who Are You? Zukyoon Through My Heart!
Episodes.Description: A mysterious duo has suddenly appeared: Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss. Uta wakes up in the middle of a dream about Cure Zukyoon, and even at school her head is full of Cure Zukyoon all day. Kokoro sees this and determines that Uta has become a fan of Cure Zukyoon.

Episodes.Title: The Pair's Vow! Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss Debut!
Episodes.Description: Cure Idol and her friends chase after Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss but lose sight of them. Sometime later, a magazine reporter who wants to learn the truth about the duo appears, and Uta and the others offer to help.

Episodes.Title: Puri! A Picnic to Find Memories!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others learn that Purirun gave up all their memories of them to become a Precure. Uta and the others invite the fairies on a picnic to try to recover Purirun's memories.

Episodes.Title: Super-Duper! A Miracle in Unison!
Episodes.Description: Uta, who fainted due to a cold, gets upset and cries about how Purirun's memories aren't returning. But once she feels better, she visits Purirun and proposes they make new memories together, and they begin taking selfies.

Episodes.Title: Idol Precure VS ZukyoonKiss?!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss are hired for a promotional campaign showdown at Pretty Holic. But Meroron sees Purirun’s usual carefree attitude and comes up with an idea…

Episodes.Title: This Is My Signature!
Episodes.Description: The Precures are asked to sign a present for a fan, and they realize they’ve never made their own signatures. At that moment, they hear the news that Kaito Hibiki has resumed his activities.

Episodes.Title: Tanakhan's Summer Holiday!
Episodes.Description: When Uta and the others learn that Tanaka hasn’t taken a summer holiday in years, they offer to do his usual jobs for him so he can rest. But when faced with a sudden day off, he’s not sure what to do with himself.

Episodes.Title: Wink in a Field of Sunflowers
Episodes.Description: Thanks to an idea from Nana, they decide to visit some sunflower fields. Nana enjoys the vast expanses of blooming sunflowers, but she can’t stop worrying about Zakkuri.

Episodes.Title: The Kyun-er the Better!
Episodes.Description: They decide to create an Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss fanclub and Kokoro works especially hard at it. While answering a question about favorite sayings for the fanclub newsletter, Kokoro remembers something from her early years.

Episodes.Title: Let's all have Kyun-Kyun hearts together!
Episodes.Description: As the Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss Fanclub gains momentum, Uta and the others decide to begin making videos for their fans on their CureTube channel. Then, at school check-in day during their summer holidays, Uta receives a letter.

Episodes.Title: Woof Woof! Together with Kyu-Chan!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others visit Grandpa Heiji Sakura’s house. They bring the family dog, Kyutaro, along and when something makes Uta feel lonely, he wants to help cheer her up.

Episodes.Title: Meroron's Friend
Episodes.Description: In response to a fan question, Idol Precure say, “We are all friends.” However, Cure Kiss can’t accept those words and takes Cure Zukyoon away, saying, “We’re not friends.”

Episodes.Title: Precure! Kirakkiran for You!
Episodes.Description: Meroron is locked in a dark capsule generated by the legendary Heart Kirari Lock. Uta and the others call Pikarine and ask about the most precious thing that Meroron locked away.

Entries.Title: Kakushite! Makina-san!!
Entries.Description:
Eita Akutsu is a gloomy, friendless, and virgin mechanical otaku. Even someone like him has a girl he admires—Makina Agatsuma, the popular and glamorous “gyaru.”

One night, as Eita returns to his lonely apartment, he finds none other than Makina crouching in front of his doorway...

Episodes.Title: Makina Is Discovered as a Robot
Episodes.Description:
Eita Akutsu is a gloomy, friendless, and virgin mechanical otaku. Even someone like him has a girl he admires—Makina Agatsuma, the popular and glamorous “gyaru.”

One night, as Eita returns to his lonely apartment, he finds none other than Makina crouching in front of his doorway...

Episodes.Title: Makina Is in My Room
Episodes.Description: Makina Agatsuma is actually an AI robot created to captivate men. She immediately sets her sights on seducing Eita Akutsu to make him her pawn. However, Eita is extremely uncomfortable with anything sexual. On top of that, Makina herself is restricted from accessing sexual content due to limitations in her programming...

Episodes.Title: Makina Bathes with a Guy
Episodes.Description: Makina, armed with inaccurate knowledge about sex, tries to seduce Eita. However, Eita, inexperienced with girls, is too busy awkwardly trying to be considerate. Sensing a lack of progress, Makina, under the pretense of taking care of him, barges into the bathroom while Eita is taking a shower.

Episodes.Title: Makina Gets a Uniform
Episodes.Description: Eita Akutsu begins living together with Makina Agatsuma to help her maintain a normal life without revealing her true identity. Carefully avoiding the watchful eyes of their landlady, the two head to a park where Eita’s close friend Mamimi is waiting. There, they’ve arranged to receive a hand-me-down school uniform for Makina.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Can No Longer Hide
Episodes.Description: Having returned to school life, Makina slips on a banana peel and falls. Eita can’t stop worrying that her malfunctioning left leg might fall off at any moment. Seeing his anxious behavior, Mamimi becomes convinced that he must be a dangerous stalker targeting Makina…

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Is Taken
Episodes.Description: Makina, whose mechanical identity must remain a secret, frantically calls Mamimi from her apartment to explain away the commotion caused at school. During the call, she starts making odd sounds due to Eita's ongoing maintenance, but somehow manages to keep her cover until the end. Just as things settle down, a mysterious girl suddenly appears at their apartment...

Episodes.Title: Thus, the Sisters Swap Places
Episodes.Description: Makina loses her body to her younger sister robot, Mimika. According to Makina, Mimika is an agent-type robot skilled at pretending to be fragile in order to manipulate others emotionally. To track down the now-missing Mimika, Eita proposes a strategy only a true mecha geek could devise.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Becomes a Ghost Story
Episodes.Description: Shrunken down to a tiny size, Makina finds herself in a tense face-off with a now gigantic Mimika. However, she’s unable to make a move—Eita is being held hostage. Mimika threatens Eita, demanding that he perform maintenance on her. As Eita trembles in fear, Makina reveals a secret plan for a dramatic comeback.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Shares a Kiss
Episodes.Description: After her dramatic comeback victory, Makina points her weapon at Mimika, intending to destroy her. Eita rushes to stop her, revealing his soft-hearted nature. Sensing this, Mimika cunningly seizes the opportunity and shows her true shrewd self. Moved by her act, Eita ends up agreeing to live together with Mimika. Seeing this, Makina becomes jealous and sulks...

Episodes.Title: Thus, the Weapon Awakens
Episodes.Description: Eita continues repairing Makina’s fragile left leg, but thanks to Mimika’s suggestion, they visit a riverside embankment that lingers in Makina’s fading memories. Meanwhile, Mamimi, still determined to take down Eita, encounters a new robotic warrior named Alma…

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Gets Covered in Burrs
Episodes.Description: After their riverside visit, Makina and Mimika return home in a panic—their hair is completely covered in burdock burrs! Meanwhile, Mamimi, now armed with Alma, devises a completely outrageous strategy to utterly defeat Eita.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Does a Naughty Workout
Episodes.Description: As Eita and Makina head to school the next day, Makina, thrilled by the improvements to her left leg, can’t stop smiling. But in gym class, disaster strikes—soft tennis is on the schedule! Eita just wants to keep a low profile, but Mamimi has other plans, setting a devious trap that will drag him right into the spotlight…

Entries.Title: The Share House's Secret Rule
Entries.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: My roommates are way too cute
Episodes.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: Come on... Touch me
Episodes.Description: Taking advantage of the "Touch Points" system his roommates suggested, Ryota and Momoka begin to get a bit closer. But after things go a little too far, the atmosphere between them turns awkward. Has Kanade noticed what’s going on? Either way, she doesn’t hold back—leaning in as Ryota massages her shoulders, she whispers, “Come on... touch me. For one minute, you can do whatever you want…”

Episodes.Title: I’ll do it for you...
Episodes.Description: Ryota uses his "Touch Points" with Kanade, and before he knows it, the two of them start getting hot and heavy... Given the recent developments, Ryota feels the dynamic with his two beautiful roommates shifting. Just then, Momoka decides it’s time to join in on the housework, declaring, “I have points from housework too... Now I'll do it for you…”

Episodes.Title: I'm just working out...!
Episodes.Description: After things heat up between Momoka and Ryota, she starts to feel embarrassed and begins avoiding him around the house. Ryota then hears a loud noise at the entrance—it’s Kanade, stumbling in, clearly drunk! With no other choice, Ryota helps her to her room. But as they reach her bed, Kanade, still tipsy, looks up at him and pleads, “Hey… you’ve still got some Touch Points left, right?”

Episodes.Title: They might hear me...
Episodes.Description: After learning that Momoka is being followed by a male student from her university, Ryota steps in to help by posing as her boyfriend to keep the stalker at bay. Though the plan succeeds, the stalker lashes out, and Ryota ends up injured while protecting her. Later, as Momoka cares for him in the hospital, the two find themselves closer than they’ve been in a long time.

Episodes.Title: You've had too much to drink...
Episodes.Description: After the restaurant that Kanade works at becomes short-staffed, she desperately asks Ryota for help. To his surprise, he encounters a completely different side of Kanade—responsible, hardworking, and mature—far from the lazy person he knows at the share house. As the night winds down, Kanade serves Ryota a drink. But after some time, a tipsy Ryota finds himself getting closer and closer to her.

Episodes.Title: We can’t do this in a movie theater...
Episodes.Description: Ryota and Kanade’s passionate connection continues to deepen, and it doesn't go unnoticed, even by Momoka. Sensing the growing tension between them, Momoka decides to invite Ryota to the movie theater to find out how he truly feels. However, Momoka ends up clinging to Ryota in fear of the scary movie. Overcome by the sight of her vulnerability, Ryota can’t help but give in to the moment.

Episodes.Title: One minute... There's no way I can stop...
Episodes.Description: Ryota overhears Momoka and Kanade talking in secret. Have they discovered that he's slept with both of them? But as if to chase away his worries, the girls suggest Ryota spend time together in the living room, with a very specific idea in mind. “Tonight, we'll fulfill one of your requests.” Ryota finds himself faced with a big decision... “One minute... There's no way I can stop...”

Entries.Title: MIRU: Paths to My Future
Entries.Description: Yoshimura, a space janitor who has spent 10 years collecting space debris is urged to retire by his boss, due to advances in AI technology. His replacement is a young pilot named Umi. While Umi takes her training seriously, Yoshimura remains unmotivated. However, the two soon find themselves facing a critical emergency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 079: Stardust ‌Memory
Episodes.Description: Yoshimura, a space janitor who has spent 10 years collecting space debris is urged to retire by his boss, due to advances in AI technology. His replacement is a young pilot named Umi. While Umi takes her training seriously, Yoshimura remains unmotivated. However, the two soon find themselves facing a critical emergency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101: The ‌King ‌of ‌the ‌Forest
Episodes.Description: Mario, who lives in a tropical rainforest, works as a tour guide, spending his days leading tourists through the forest. However, the forest has gradually changed since he was a child. Then one day, he stumbles upon an illegal gold mining site…

Episodes.Title: Episode 217: Londonderry Air
Episodes.Description: Ame attends music school, pursuing her dream of becoming a professional pianist. While she works at a construction site to pay for her tuition, her secret joy is playing a public piano on a street corner. One day, her piano skills are noticed, and she is invited to participate in an AI demonstration experiment…

Episodes.Title: Episode 630: Re: MIRU
Episodes.Description: In a world plagued by division, conflict, and worsening global warming, a young diplomat, Toshi, returns home after successfully brokering a peace negotiation. But his moment of relief is short-lived, as news of the negotiation’s collapse plunges him into despair. Exhausted and wandering the streets aimlessly, he is unexpectedly saved by an unremarkable, middle-aged man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 926: Wait, I’ll Be There
Episodes.Description: In a frozen post-apocalyptic world, Airu travels with her companion Pochimaru. Their mission is to travel the world making flowers bloom using the “magic sand” left behind by her mother, a botanist. Deep in a mountain of dead trees, they meet Izumif, a boy who says he’s from the distant future…

Entries.Title: Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
Entries.Description: The year is 50... no, wait, it's 78 B.C.! In a village in Gaul, Getafix is working on a magic potion and Obelix doesn't yet have superhuman strength.

Episodes.Title: Episode I
Episodes.Description: The year is 50... no, wait, it's 78 B.C.! In a village in Gaul, Getafix is working on a magic potion and Obelix doesn't yet have superhuman strength.

Episodes.Title: Episode II
Episodes.Description: Determined to defeat the indomitable Gauls, Caesar decides to use their own laws against them. In the forest, Getafix comes across some pesky Romans...

Episodes.Title: Episode III
Episodes.Description: A Gallo-Roman chieftain challenges Vitalstatistix. Meanwhile, a centurion spies on Getafix, who tries to make the magic potion with explosive results.

Episodes.Title: Episode IV
Episodes.Description: With the fight fast approaching, the Gauls desperately search for another way to win — stirring even more trouble between Asterix and Obelix.

Episodes.Title: Episode V
Episodes.Description: As the Romans' dastardly plans for Gaul reach a boiling point, Metadata questions her loyalty and Asterix pulls out all the stops to save the village.

Entries.Title: Princession Orchestra
Entries.Description: Minamo and her best friend Natsu encountered a strange land called Alicepia where they go to a live event held here. However, the event was attacked by a group of monsters called Jamaocks. At that moment, Minamo witnessed a Princess who sings and dance to defeat the monster.

Episodes.Title: What a Wonderful World
Episodes.Description: Minamo and her best friend Natsu encountered a strange land called Alicepia where they go to a live event held here. However, the event was attacked by a group of monsters called Jamaocks. At that moment, Minamo witnessed a Princess who sings and dance to defeat the monster.

Episodes.Title: The Girl's Best Efforts
Episodes.Description:
Minamo Sorano transforms into Princess Ripple but continues to struggle against monsters due to her inexperience. Just then, Princess Zeal, whom she saw recently at a concert venue, comes to her rescue and saves the day.

The true identity of Princess Zeal is Kagari Shirube, who happens to be Natsu Hinomoto’s idol and someone she deeply admires. Minamo learns more about the Princesses and the monsters known as Jamaock from Kagari.

Entries.Title: Uglymug, Epicfighter
Entries.Description: Shigeru Yoshioka is a very ugly man who tries to reincarnate in another world, disgusted with life.

Episodes.Title: An Epicgod is Born
Episodes.Description: Shigeru Yoshioka is a very ugly man who tries to reincarnate in another world, disgusted with life.

Episodes.Title: Exploring Epic Dungeon
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and his group spend their first day in the city and set out to explore their first dungeon.

Episodes.Title: Hero's Epic Burning
Episodes.Description: After his transformation, Seiji is determined to take down Kyoshiro's band of bandits.

Episodes.Title: One-Arm Epic Danger
Episodes.Description: Shigeru's group heads to Valleria, but they decide to camp halfway to rest.

Episodes.Title: Epic Angel Descends
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and Reeze stop Reia from hurting Seika. Then, Seika transforms into an angel to help Reia.

Episodes.Title: Epic Undercover Mission
Episodes.Description: In Valleria, the party goes to a casino. Then, the hall master Kajita invites Seika to join the Extra Stage.

Episodes.Title: Villainous Epic Master
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and Seika reach the Extra Stage of the casino to uncover Kajita’s “Liberation plan.”

Episodes.Title: Epic Colosseum Showdown
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and the team barge into the battlefield, where they find out Kajita’s terrifying power.

Episodes.Title: Starting an Epic Company
Episodes.Description: Shigeru’s mind is on Karina and Ordnung Spear. Then, a man who looks like Shigeru’s former boss appears.

Entries.Title: The Unaware Atelier Meister
Entries.Description: After he's fired from his party of heroes, the 15-year-old Kurt turns to a temp agency for work.

Episodes.Title: The Guy in Charge of Chores with Low Self-Esteem Turned Out to Actually Possess Incredible Skills
Episodes.Description: After he's fired from his party of heroes, the 15-year-old Kurt turns to a temp agency for work.

Episodes.Title: His First Atelier
Episodes.Description: Kurt accepts an offer from Bandana to go work at his first Atelier, which harbors a dangerous secret.

Episodes.Title: What Mining Means To Him
Episodes.Description: While Ophelia and the others discuss plans to uncover who cursed Liselotte, Kurt takes a job as a porter.

Episodes.Title: New Friends in a New Atelier
Episodes.Description: Yulishia establishes a new atelier in the frontier town without letting Kurt know he's its atelier meister.

Episodes.Title: A Frontier Town With Enemies at All Sides
Episodes.Description: Tristan & a demon lord force Marlefiss to summon hordes of monsters to attack the town in order to kill Lise.

Episodes.Title: The Ninth Direction
Episodes.Description: Kurt tunnels into the ruins from underground and saves Marlefiss while his allies defeat the demon lord.

Episodes.Title: The New Papa of a Mysterious Egg
Episodes.Description: After helping a village with a water shortage, Kurt receives an egg that hatches into a 3-year old girl.

Episodes.Title: Akuri's Fwoosh
Episodes.Description: While Kurt and Yulishia help a farm with their pigs, a demon tries to take away Akuri.

Episodes.Title: Lise's Confession
Episodes.Description: Mimico reports on Akuri and interrogates Solflare. Then Kurt & Lise go on a date before the rescue mission.

Episodes.Title: Yulishia's Date
Episodes.Description: Yulishia's date with Kurt is ruined when thugs harass a local meat bun shop over a cooking competition.

Episodes.Title: The Margrave's Secret
Episodes.Description: While the group distracts the Margrave, Akuri warps Kurt into the forbidden room hiding the Margrave's secret.

Episodes.Title: A Common Story About How the Former Head of Chores for a Party of Heroes Was Actually SSS-Rank in All Except Combat Skills
Episodes.Description: The Margrave tries to summon a demon to save his daughter. After he fails, the mastermind summons it anyway.

Entries.Title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
Entries.Description: Zenos, an unlicensed healer working in the shadows, works to fix what's ailing his patients.

Episodes.Title: An Equal Price
Episodes.Description: Zenos, an unlicensed healer working in the shadows, works to fix what's ailing his patients.

Episodes.Title: The Underground Healer in the Abandoned Part of Town
Episodes.Description: Kicked out of his party for his unorthodox skills and humble origins, Zenos seeks a new way of life.

Episodes.Title: Turf War
Episodes.Description: An encounter with the chief of the orcs leads Zenos into a three-way standoff in the slums.

Episodes.Title: A Righteous Hero
Episodes.Description: Zenos resolving the feud between the demihuman gangs attracts attention from an unwanted source.

Episodes.Title: A Place to Belong
Episodes.Description: Zenos' old party find themselves at an impasse, and wondering if they kicked out the reason for their success.

Episodes.Title: The End of Adventure
Episodes.Description: A rampaging golem threatens the slums as Zenos is forced to organize a resistance.

Episodes.Title: Special Service
Episodes.Description: After having dealt with the the rampaging golem, Zenos and his friends visit a hot springs to recuperate.

Episodes.Title: The Royal Hospital
Episodes.Description: Zenos attends class at the Royal Hospital's headquarters, under the assumed identity of "Zeno."

Episodes.Title: Faction Infiltration
Episodes.Description: Zenos' gets an invite to the Goldran Laboratory, and a chance to track down Becker's missing student.

Episodes.Title: A Request from a Noble Lady
Episodes.Description: A request for Zenos to treat Lord Fennel's daughter ends up being complicated by her haughty attitude.

Episodes.Title: Just a Normal Healer
Episodes.Description: Zenos is invited to a dinner party by Goldran, where he hopes to discover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Choosing Who Lives
Episodes.Description: Zenos learns the truth behind Becker's investigation, and faces the question: are lives equal in value?

Entries.Title: The Daily Life of a Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
Entries.Description: Kenichi, a single man close to 40, suddenly finds himself standing in the woods of another world. After realizing his Skill lets him use the major online retailer "Shangri-La" from his original world, he exchanges items from this new world for money and purchases various products to survive outdoors. However, his life is soon thrown in peril as he finds himself surrounded by monsters.

Episodes.Title: An Unfamiliar Forest
Episodes.Description: Kenichi, a single man close to 40, suddenly finds himself standing in the woods of another world. After realizing his Skill lets him use the major online retailer "Shangri-La" from his original world, he exchanges items from this new world for money and purchases various products to survive outdoors. However, his life is soon thrown in peril as he finds himself surrounded by monsters.

Episodes.Title: Curry Is Justice!
Episodes.Description: Kenichi is steadily increasing his sales when Myaley and other beastfolk are lured into him by the smell of spices. He refuses to sell spices to them so he can stay off the radar of the spice syndicates, but he gives into pressure from the beastfolk and offers an alternative. Primula, the first daughter of the Mallow Trading Company appears before Kenichi.

Episodes.Title: A Small House in a Big Forest
Episodes.Description: Kenichi decides to live in the forest, but first he must build a cabin with all its accessories in order to lead a peaceful life.

Episodes.Title: Adventurers (Kenichi and His 8 Allies)
Episodes.Description: Primula has been kidnapped by bandits! Kenichi gathers some allies and heads off to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Over an Old Castle
Episodes.Description: After rescuing Primula, Kenichi returns to collect his reward and sell their loot, but now it's only a matter of time before he attracts the attention of the nobles.

Episodes.Title: The Book Loving...
Episodes.Description: Kenichi re-establishes his base at the lake near Astrantia where he makes picture books with Anemone and Anemone makes a new friend her age.

Episodes.Title: Creep Forth!
Episodes.Description: After fending off an attack on Crouton, Kenichi secures the Chicory to save Mary and helps them immigrate to Norspaul before Primula finally catches up to him in Astrantia.

Episodes.Title: The Timid Mage
Episodes.Description: Primula establishes a restaurant in Astrantia and brings home her new bodyguard, the catwoman, Nyamena, while Kenichi mines gems from a cliffside.

Episodes.Title: So It's a Spider, So What?
Episodes.Description: Myaley discovers a dungeon near their home that harbors gems and giant cave spiders. While her and Kenichi try to clear it out, Primula's restaurants deal with harassment from the spice syndicate.

Episodes.Title: The Story of Canals
Episodes.Description: The Eupatorium Viscountcy is behind on their mandated construction of a public canal, so the nobles turn to Kenichi for aid, and Primula learns Thogalum has been ripping off the nobles and the construction crew.

Episodes.Title: Shock!
Episodes.Description: Kenichi briefly looks for information on Anemone's mother, and then Mallow arrives so they can root Thogalum out of the Eupatorium Viscountcy.

Episodes.Title: The Unreasonable, Mischievous Princess
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: To Sa-Kura
Episodes.Description: Forced to fight, Kenichi threatens the nation before Princess Lilith offers him a way to back down.

Entries.Title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
Entries.Description: Average salaryman Kitase Kazuhiro's hobby is sleeping. In his dreams, he visits a fantasy world where he adventures with an elf he's befriended named Marie. But one day when he wakes, the girl he's only seen in his dreams is there beside him!

Episodes.Title: Good Morning, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Average salaryman Kitase Kazuhiro's hobby is sleeping. In his dreams, he visits a fantasy world where he adventures with an elf he's befriended named Marie. But one day when he wakes, the girl he's only seen in his dreams is there beside him!

Episodes.Title: Have a Katsu-don, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiro and Marie enjoy a day in Japan. Later, they theorize that they'll be able to return to Marie's world if they fall asleep together. That leaves just one problem—they'll wake in the same place they left, with an angry Arkdragon lying in wait!

Entries.Title: CITY THE ANIMATION
Entries.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Matsuri and Eri enjoying their after-school adventures. Todoroki and Onikamaboko struggle to create a joke for "Rakutan-kun." After hearing Niikura's dream, Nagumo starts thinking what they want to do. Something starting to blossom in CITY.

Episodes.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Matsuri and Eri enjoying their after-school adventures. Todoroki and Onikamaboko struggle to create a joke for "Rakutan-kun." After hearing Niikura's dream, Nagumo starts thinking what they want to do. Something starting to blossom in CITY.

Perpetually broke Nagumo faces off against Niikura, who just wants her money back. When Wako joins in, their chaotic campus life kicks into high gear. Meanwhile, the CITY Minami Eleven soccer team scrambles to protect their always-injured ace, Sasago. Todoroki negotiates the fate of Rakutan-kun—testing the bond between editor and author. And the sun sets on CITY.

With a performance approaching, Tekaridake Theater's leader, Tekaridake, tries to rally his unmotivated troupe. Sleepwalker Riko Izumi steals the heart of 16-year-old Tatewaku Makabe. Spring is just around the corner. Matsuri and Eri share kindness to protect world peace. Nagumo, Niikura, and Wako find a treasure map—let the battle begin! Another peaceful day in CITY.

Tanabe loves handing out awards for anything and everything, and now she begins the search for Nagumo! Tsurubishi visits the izakaya 'Yamabushi,' eager to get the iconic 'Boss! The usual!' and starts frequenting it. Niikura chases after a pendant that got caught on a 'Mimineko.' Matsuri and Eri embark on a big adventure chasing the Mimineko. The lives of each person intersect in CITY.

Nagumo is taken away by Tanabe. Their destination is the Tanabe Residence Hospitality Twin Towers. With the help of a kind person they meet along the way, Nagumo and Wako try to escape, but the guardians on each floor block their path... Meanwhile, Niikura continues to run recklessly, chasing the Mimineko. Disconnected dots begin to connect in CITY!

The Adataras' morning is always busy. Umi, Sora, Kamome, Tatsuta, and Ryota, all head off together as usual. An anonymous manuscript titled 'Kanki-kun' arrives at the CITY magazine editorial office. Feeling something special about it, Todoroki makes a proposal to Onikamaboko. At the riverside at dusk, Eri tries to convey something to Matsuri... The seasons of CITY continue to change.

Taking over for the owner of Café Yamabushi, Tsurubishi sets out to make the ultimate fried rice. With pride, he embarks on a journey to find the perfect ingredients. Late night, Niikura is struck by hunger and eats whatever she can. Meanwhile, Kuratake, the barber known as “the baddest guy in CITY,” been selling off gifts from his regulars. In CITY, there's no light without a little darkness.

A girl in love can't stop sighing. After 18 years of waiting for an invitation, Tanabe finally learns his crush's favorite food?! Tekaridake casts Nagumo as the lead in "Throat". Despite endless NGs, he powers through—and the curtain rises! A police officer becomes a fan of Riko Izumi. Tatewaku, too, ends up asking her out. Something is blooming in CITY.

The CITY race with a 1-million-yen prize is on. Nagumo competes against Obaba. Niikura aims to steal pendant from the CITY Minami Eleven. Tekaridake runs with a pair in tow. Matsuri and Eri move in sync. The Three Crows hold fine sake in hand. With surprises at every turn, the unpredictable race keeps everyone on edge. Who will win the race? As everyone runs, CITY begins to spin!

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 2 / Here's a message from the dead File 1
Episodes.Description: Mystery butler Kageyama concocts a peculiar plan to catch the criminal lurking in a luxury hotel, after which Reiko and her friends realize the hidden complexity of their own emotions. Reiko then tackles the murder case of a real estate tycoon. Each of the victim's relatives harbor suspicious motives to kill, but a single photograph proves essential in accelerating this perplexing investigation.

Episodes.Title: Here's a message from the dead File 2
Episodes.Description: While investigating the murder of a real estate tycoon, Reiko examines an erased dying message, a bloody trophy, and a cord yanked from the curtains. Without proof, however, she reaches a dead end...until savage butler Kageyama emerges to solve the mystery. Reiko and Kyoichiro think outside the box to trap the murderer, peek inside the victim's mindset, and end a chain of events fueled by revenge.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 1
Episodes.Description: With Kageyama as her chauffeur, Reiko and her friends visit a crowded summer festival, where a cracked smartphone is discovered. Its owner was poisoned in his apartment, and he died wearing nothing but briefs. Three women the victim dated simultaneously on a matching app fail to match the height of a suspect seen exiting his residence, which leaves Reiko puzzled at the true culprit's identity.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 2 / The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 1
Episodes.Description: Women of differing heights are spotted at the crime scene. Kageyama suspects that elevator shoes disguised the murderer's appearance. After learning that the victim had scammed several women via dating apps, Reiko inches closer to the truth. Later, a delivery man is found dead with an item belonging to his favorite VTuber, and it's discovered that the two even frequented the same hospital.

Episodes.Title: The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 2
Episodes.Description: After a delivery man falls to his death, Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate his connection to popular VTuber "Kuru Kuru-Chan," who is blamed for the murder by fans online. Kageyama assists in analyzing a mystery figure planting bugs, untouched food deliveries, and hints to the true culprit left at the crime scene. The victim leaves a note reading, "I've had enough of this world," but in what context?

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 1
Episodes.Description: A famous painter is stabbed in his own studio, pointing to his masterpiece wall painting "Sleeping Beauty" just before dying. Suspects include his art-jacking son, his second wife, and an art magazine writer with whom he supposedly had an affair. Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate how the killer escaped a locked studio, eventually learning of the victim's connection to a certain "Appraisal Queen."

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 2 / Please don't drown in this river File 1
Episodes.Description: Kageyama locates a secret passageway to solve the locked-room murder mystery. Upon encountering a deranged woman wielding a knife, Reiko is left with nowhere to escape. On the next case, a white-suited journalist's body is discovered by the river. Despite being dry, his cause of death is drowning. With debts to pay, he had targeted a well-known "Shaketopia" actress whom Reiko adored as a child.

Episodes.Title: Please don't drown in this river File 2
Episodes.Description: Journalist Ryota Ishiguro's body is found on the riverbank, but although the cause of his death is drowning, the body is dry. Reiko's investigations lead her to Shiho and Satoshi Kambara, a loving couple from whom Ishiguro had been demanding money, but they claim to have an alibi. The discovery of a silver spoon with the engraving "Shiho to Leo" takes the case in an unexpected direction.

Episodes.Title: Murder lies in a beautiful rose
Episodes.Description: A woman's body is found in a bed of blooming roses at the prestigious Fujikura residence. The victim is Toshio Fujikura's fiancée, and the suspects include members of the family. Reiko, who happens to be their neighbor, is fearful that her identity will be exposed. As the investigation continues, they discover that the victim's pet cat is missing, which may be a key to solving the case.

Episodes.Title: The bride is behind locked doors
Episodes.Description: Reiko attends the wedding of Sawamura Yuri, who she cherishes like a younger sister. The groom is Hosoyama, a consultant for a family friend. When Yuri is attacked and gravely injured in her room during the party, Reiko risks her identity being revealed to help solve the case. But when the crime scene is found to be a perfect locked room, Reiko is suspected of being an accomplice.

Episodes.Title: What is it that you have lost?
Episodes.Description: Trouble strikes the Sawamura family again when Miyuki Sawamura is kidnapped and a ransom of 50 million yen is demanded. With no other suspects, Reiko sets her sights on Hosoyama. She takes Kageyama to the ransom handover disguised as a couple. Despite the perpetrator's traps, they inch closer to the truth, and find that the case is connected to an incident that occurred three years prior.

Entries.Title: Umamusume: Cinderella Gray
Entries.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: I'm Here
Episodes.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Race
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and Belno Light are officially scouted by Jo Kitahara. Seeing as a racer needs to belong to a team in order to race, Oguri Cap accepts and begins training for her debut race. When the day arrives, she finds the student hailed as their generation's ace—Fujimasa March—waiting for her...

Episodes.Title: View from the Top
Episodes.Description: Up until now, Oguri Cap has simply run because she can, but after her heated race with Fujimasa March, her heart wells with a new, bitter emotion. As Oguri Cap and her team ensure she's properly prepared for her next race, another opponent shows her face: Norn Ace. Annoyed by Oguri Cap, Norn Ace's friends propose a certain "strategy" to her...

Episodes.Title: The Junior Crown
Episodes.Description: The day of the Junior Crown is here, and Oguri Cap and Fujimasa March make good on the promise they made at Mt. Kinka to enter. While Oguri Cap had no answer when Fujimasa March asked her for her goal back then, her aspirations will surely take shape during this race with her rival.

Episodes.Title: What's Best for Her
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and the rest of her team make their way to Chukyo Racecourse for the Chukyo Hai, but Kitahara can't shake Musaka's ominous words from his mind. Brows furrowed, he heads for the stands, only to discover Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky have come to observe the race.

Episodes.Title: The Beast
Episodes.Description: After Symboli Rudolf offers his trainee a place in the Twinkle Series, Kitahara approaches a reluctant Oguri Cap with a wager—if she wins the Gold Junior, she'll transfer to the nationals; otherwise, they'll aim for the Tokai Derby. As she heads into the race, Oguri Cap remains conflicted. She wants to give her all in her long-awaited battle against March, but...

Episodes.Title: Tracen Academy
Episodes.Description: Musaka gives Tracen Academy's two newest students—Oguri Cap and Belno Light—a tour of the expansive campus. Afterwards, Oguri Cap comes face to face with her new classmates—and potential rivals. As class begins, the teacher explains the goal of many of her contemporaries, the G1 Classic Triple Crown. There's just one problem...

Episodes.Title: The Right Stuff
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap's transfer from Kasamatsu has unfortunately overlapped with the registration deadline for the Classic races. Eager to show Symboli Rudolf she has what it takes to take on these races, she sets her sights on the G3 Pegasus Stakes. But standing in her way is a racer with four consecutive wins under her belt...

Episodes.Title: The Japanese Derby
Episodes.Description: Symboli Rudolf witnesses Oguri Cap's might firsthand—the no-name racer from the boonies wipes the floor with even the strong national racers. In her, Symboli Rudolf sees a star capable of setting the Twinkle Series alight. But should she use her authority to advocate for a miracle at the Japan Derby, or should she remain loyal to the rules?

Episodes.Title: The Peak
Episodes.Description: Ultimately, Oguri Cap is unable to enter the Japanese Derby, which means she needs a new racing goal. Hoping to inspire Oguri Cap, Musaka takes her and Belno Light to see the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where the lineup is decided by a fan poll. There, Oguri Cap witnesses the racer currently dominating the Twinkle Series.

Episodes.Title: The Star of Kasamatsu
Episodes.Description: Musaka declares that if Oguri Cap wants to take on Tamamo Cross in the fall Tenno Sho, she has to win the Mainichi Okan. A task easier said than done, as Oguri Cap's winning streak means all her rivals' eyes are on her. This year's Mainichi Okan is shaping up to be a ten-versus-one race...

Episodes.Title: The Fall Tenno Sho
Episodes.Description: At last, the day of the fall Tenno Sho arrives, and with it, the first clash between the two ashen-haired Umamusume, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Hoping to surpass the top racer and become the best in all of Japan, Oguri Cap steps onto the turf. Although Tamamo Cross holds a similar dream, there's a special someone in her heart as she enters the course.

Episodes.Title: Japan's Best
Episodes.Description: The crowd is on the edge of their seats as the racers enter the homestretch of the fall Tenno Sho. With 400 meters remaining, each runner musters the last of their strength. With Oguri Cap right on her tail, Tamamo Cross begins to feel the pressure. As exhaustion creeps in, her past flashes before her eyes. Her loved ones in her heart, Tamamo Cross breaks past her limits and enters a zone beyond her rivals...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Strict Aunt's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi, a third-year college student, leads a lazy life drinking cheap and tasty canned chuhai. One day, his aunt, Yui Koriyama, who he has a soft spot for, pays him an unexpected visit.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Sun-Kissed Gyaru's Lips
Episodes.Description: On a midsummer's day, Tsuyoshi heads to the convenience store to get chuhai, and reunites with Ai Natsuno, his junior from high school. Ai is now married, with a huge makeover as a sun-kissed gyaru, but acts like a spoiled child around Tsuyoshi, just like she used to.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Married Club Senpai's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi starts an online drinking session with his two guy friends, and the college idol senpai, Miki Kanzaki. As Miki gets drunk from canned chuhai and exposes herself on screen, Tsuyoshi and the gang can't take their eyes off her.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Russian Friend's Sister's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi goes round Joseph's house and meets his older sister and married Russian beauty, Anastasia. The three have canned chuhai, but Anastasia gets dead drunk and mistakes Tsuyoshi for her younger brother. He ends up taking care of her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Mysterious, Tanuki-Faced Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: One night when Tsuyoshi was wandering around town with canned chuhai in his hand, he meets a wild tanuki, and gets led to a big mansion. There he meets a tanuki-faced beauty, Tamami Miyazawa, who gives him a warm reception, but for a certain reason...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Baby-Faced, Cheeky Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: By chance, Tsuyoshi ends up having a one-night stand with Nozomi Kuji, a married woman who looks too young for her age. Since then, they've become canned chuhai drinking buddies. In the midst of this, Nozomi vents out her frustration about her busty-loving hubby, and Tsuyoshi gets lectured on the appeal of small breasts...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of an Otherworldly, Married Dark Elf's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi enters a parallel universe and saves a dark elf beauty, Symphis with the skill he gained from the chuhai god. Tsuyoshi gradually becomes drawn to Symphis as she talks about her husband, but something doesn't add up...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Quiet Former Rebel, the Barbershop Owner's Lips
Episodes.Description: As Tsuyoshi goes to his regular barbershop, the quiet forty-odd beauty owner, Sari Kirihara, announces that the shop will be closing down. Tsuyoshi ends up drinking canned chuhai at Sari's house without the presence of her husband, but realizing her secret feelings, tries to snuggle up to her...

Episodes.Title: I Don’t Want to Be Anyone but Myself

Episodes.Title: I Don’t Know What Lies Around the Bend, but I’m Going to Believe That the Best Does

Episodes.Title: I’d Like to Add Some Beauty to Life
Episodes.Description: Anne becomes a full-fledged schoolma'am and encounters all sorts and conditions of men... and women.

Episodes.Title: Perhaps We Always Love Best the People Who Need Us

Episodes.Title: It Is Never Too Late for the Real Prince to Come for the True Princess

Episodes.Title: I’ll Come From the Ends of the Earth If Necessary
Episodes.Description: Anne wonders what lies around the bend in her road and attends a wedding at the stone house.

Episodes.Title: It’s Nicer Not to Know
Episodes.Description: The shadow of change leads to greetings and farewells as Anne sets off for Redmond College.

Episodes.Title: Love Is the Power That Transforms Everything
Episodes.Description: After letters from home and a day in the park, Anne goes home again and gets her first proposal.

Episodes.Description: Anne deals with an unwelcome lover and a welcome friend, visits Patty's Place, and finds roses of yesterday.

Entries.Title: Farmagia
Entries.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Chaos
Episodes.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion of Avrion
Episodes.Description: Airing on Friday, January 17, 2025 Ten and Leii face off against the masked warrior Zanas, who attacks an orphanage. Overwhelmed by the vast difference in their abilities as Farmagias, the two find themselves in a dire situation. However, with the timely assistance of Nares, they manage to successfully repel Zanas. After the battle, gazing upon the ruins of the burned-down orphanage, Ten and the others resolve to rebel against the new Magus, Glaza.

Episodes.Title: Reunion in Enemy Territory
Episodes.Description: To defeat Manas, Ten, Leii, and Arche infiltrate Perfectus as an elite strike team, aiming for the castle. During their mission, they reunite with their missing comrade, Emero. While Ten is overjoyed by the reunion, Emero gazes at them with a stern expression and utters a chilling remark.

Episodes.Title: Uniting Bonds
Episodes.Description: Determined to match Emero, who demonstrated mastery over controlling monster powers, Ten repeatedly attempts to "Unite" but fails no matter how hard he tries, growing increasingly frustrated. Then, Emero appears before Ten and the others once more, but this time, he shows even greater hostility toward them.

Episodes.Title: To the City of Muscles
Episodes.Description: After defeating Manas and returning to Avrion, Ten and the others let Arche rest to recover from a sudden collapse. Ten and Leii then head to their next destination, Rahatluk, on their own. Successfully infiltrating the city, they pull a cart through the streets, only to realize someone is hiding in the cargo. That person is...

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Corpses
Episodes.Description: As Ten and the others panic over Chica's disappearance, Zanas once again stands in their way. Effortlessly deflecting their attacks, Zanas reveals that Chica has been captured by the Corpus before leaving. Determined to ensure their dear comrade's safety, Ten and his group rush to Rahatluk Fortress.

Episodes.Title: In return for the Truth
Episodes.Description: After a fierce battle with the Corpus, Ten and his group emerge victorious. Returning to Avrion, they throw a party to celebrate Emero's return. While everyone enjoys the festivities, Ten, worried about Arche’s absence due to poor health, goes to visit her—only to discover that she has disappeared. Together with his comrades, Ten desperately searches for her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Ones
Episodes.Description: Receiving a report from Anzar, who has infiltrated Sonrisa and uncovered the guard placements, Nares assigns Ten and the group the mission to defeat L'Oreille. They land in Sonrisa and begin their advance, but while Anzar steps away to scout the enemy, they are ambushed by L'Oreille, Zanas, and Glaza.

Episodes.Title: The Three Angels
Episodes.Description: On the day of peace negotiations, Nares faces L'Oreille with her army on the continent of. Tension fills the air as Ten and the others quietly observe the two. Declaring no intent to attack, Nares speaks calmly, but L'Oreille, with a sinister smile, unleashes the supposedly undecipherable grand magic, "Harvest Festival.

Episodes.Title: Through the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Nares wakes up in the Magus’s castle, where she is shocked to see the Oración Seis, who were believed to be dead. To her further confusion, Lisan mocks her, and standing before her is the former Magus, Diluculum. Meanwhile, Ten and the others, assaulted by L'Oreille, are swallowed by an impenetrable darkness with no light in sight.

Episodes.Title: The Path of the Brother
Episodes.Description: Having completely lost their sense of self, the Oración Seis transform into Reapers and charge at Ten and the others with terrifying roars. Each of them faces a one-on-one battle, but Ten, confronted by Nares, hesitates to fight. Unable to summon any monsters, he desperately continues to call out to her, torn and unsure of what to do.

Episodes.Title: Dragons of Centvelt
Episodes.Description: Together with Anzar, who has regained his sense of self, Ten and the others challenge the Magus Diluculum to a final battle. However, even their strongest attacks have no effect on Diluculum. As the world gradually collapses due to the "Grand Harvest Festival," Ten and his comrades continue to struggle desperately, refusing to give up.

Entries.Title: Gachiakuta
Entries.Description: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

Episodes.Title: The Sphere
Episodes.Description: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

Episodes.Title: The Inhabited
Episodes.Description: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

Episodes.Title: The Ground
Episodes.Description: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

Episodes.Title: Cleaner HQ
Episodes.Description: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

Episodes.Title: Raiders
Episodes.Description: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.

Episodes.Title: One Good Strike!!
Episodes.Description: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.

Episodes.Title: A Score to Settle
Episodes.Description: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.

Episodes.Title: Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.

Entries.Title: Iyanu
Entries.Description: Iyanu, aka The Chosen, triggers her Divine Powers, escapes Elu, and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind the evil lurking in Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Chosen
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, aka The Chosen, triggers her Divine Powers, escapes Elu, and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind the evil lurking in Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Exiles
Episodes.Description: Fleeing evil Chancellor Nuro, Iyanu meets the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and Biyi. As she uncovers her powers, she explores hidden Wonders beyond Elu.

Episodes.Title: The Eso of Eso
Episodes.Description: Kanfo, leader of the Eso Warriors, brings his son Toye to hunt Iyanu, while she meets Mama Sewa, a sage with secret knowledge of her past and powers.

Episodes.Title: The Arrival
Episodes.Description: As Elu's political climate worsens, Iyanu intensifies her training with Sewa while two armies converge on the Riverlands Settlement to capture her.

Episodes.Title: The People of the Deep
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, Biyi and Sewa battle the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and the People of the Deep, while Elu's Workers demand justice from the King and Nuro.

Episodes.Title: The Walk of Death
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, Biyi, Toye and Ekun (aka TEAM CHOSEN) cross The Rinku Plains to find The Source, key to Iyanu's powers and lifting the Curse on Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Betrayal
Episodes.Description: As Elu falls into civil war, Biyi and the Oba share stories of heartbreak. Team Chosen struggles to reach The Source while Olori searches for Iyanu.

Episodes.Title: The Sacred
Episodes.Description: Team Chosen reaches The Sacred Settlement, where Iyanu must pass three Trials to prove she's The Chosen, while Nuro, now possessed, pursues them.

Episodes.Title: The Source (1)
Episodes.Description: As Cursed animals besiege Elu, Iyanu searches for The Source. Meanwhile, Biyi, Toye, Olori and Kanfo battle Nuro's forces to buy time for Iyanu.

Episodes.Title: The Source (2)
Episodes.Description: Iyanu reaches The Source and faces a devastating choice. As Elu nears destruction, her allies fight a final battle against Nuro and the Fallen One.

Episodes.Title: Iyanu: The Age of Wonders
Episodes.Description: Ages before The Chosen, Yorubaland thrives -- until the diabolical Meje appears. Warriors Dara and Ishe must stop it and prevent the Age of Darkness.

Episodes.Title: Rintaro and Kaoruko
Episodes.Description: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

Episodes.Title: Chidori and Kikyo
Episodes.Description: Tensions between the two schools escalate during a commotion at Chidori's gates. Later, Rintaro finds a surprise visitor waiting at the patisserie.

Episodes.Title: A Kind Person
Episodes.Description: Desperate to improve their grades, Rintaro and Shohei cram in the library. There, Rintaro runs into Kaoruko, but their tender moment gets interrupted.

Episodes.Title: Warmth of the Heart
Episodes.Description: Though Rintaro becomes more comfortable with Kaoruko during their study session, he faces unexpectedly strong opposition to their growing bond.

Episodes.Title: Premonition of a New Beginning
Episodes.Description: Pressure mounts as Rintaro's friends discover a note from Kaoruko hidden in his notebook. Saku's frustration towards Rintaro's reticence grows.

Episodes.Title: Self-Loathing / I Love You!
Episodes.Description: It's an important night of confessions, apologies and cherished memories when Subaru and Kaoruko catch up at the park where they used to play as kids.

Episodes.Title: Coolest Guy Ever
Episodes.Description: Noticing Rintaro's strange behavior, Shohei, Saku and Ayato follow him after school and try to eavesdrop on his meeting with Kaoruko and Subaru.

Episodes.Title: The Meaning of These Feelings
Episodes.Description: Despite the awkwardness, Rintaro manages to introduce his friends to the girls. Later, Kaoruko makes a bold suggestion on how Rintaro could repay her.

Episodes.Title: Blond Hair and Pierced Ears
Episodes.Description: While Rintaro struggles with his tangled emotions about Kaoruko, he invites his friends over to his home — but two unexpected visitors shake things up.

Entries.Title: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
Entries.Description: He spent his life working for a black company, only to learn that his beloved daughter was born from the man his wife spent years cheating on him with - his own boss. Yearning for revenge on his death bed, he's reincarnated in a space fantasy as the Evil Lord Liam.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: He spent his life working for a black company, only to learn that his beloved daughter was born from the man his wife spent years cheating on him with - his own boss. Yearning for revenge on his death bed, he's reincarnated in a space fantasy as the Evil Lord Liam.

Episodes.Title: Rebirth
Episodes.Description: At the ripe age of 5, Liam is gifted a custom-order AI robot by his parents, and then granted full control of their fiefdom, the stellar system of Alcaeus, so they can abandon him for the capital and leave him shouldered with the family's debts.

Episodes.Title: Way of the Flash
Episodes.Description: Liam retains a martial arts instructor of questionable character.

Episodes.Title: First Battle
Episodes.Description: Nias customizes the Avid. Liam masters Flash, then defends his mine from pirates.

Episodes.Title: Honey Trap
Episodes.Description: Liam uses his loot from the pirates to replace his fleet and Nias tries to seduce him into buying her ships.

Episodes.Title: Treasure Island
Episodes.Description: Logs on the pirate ships reveals their home base and Liam argues with the warp gate so he can go raid them.

Episodes.Title: Princess Knight
Episodes.Description: Goaz tortures Christiania and her soldiers, grotesquely modifying their bodies. Liam rescues them.

Episodes.Title: Harem Project
Episodes.Description: Liam tries to build an NTR harem, but struggles because over 10,000 women are ready to eagerly consent to it.

Episodes.Title: Mass-Produced Maids
Episodes.Description: Liam laments not being more of an evil lord but his people & robots love him. The Guide leads pirates to him.

Episodes.Title: Decisive Battle
Episodes.Description: The Goaz pirates declare war on the Banfield domain, and Liam faces them in battle.

Episodes.Title: Evil Lord
Episodes.Description: Liam routs the pirates and faces Goaz in a final showdown.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: After hearing about Liam's success, his good-for-nothing family comes begging for more money.

Entries.Title: ZENSHU
Entries.Description: An up-and-coming anime director, Natsuko Hirose, is busy trying to storyboard a rom-com themed feature film, but because she's never experienced first love, she can't seem to progress with her storyboards.

Episodes.Title: FIRST STROKE
Episodes.Description: An up-and-coming anime director, Natsuko Hirose, is busy trying to storyboard a rom-com themed feature film, but because she's never experienced first love, she can't seem to progress with her storyboards.

Episodes.Title: DEFEND
Episodes.Description: The prophet of the Last Town, Elder Baobab, decides that Natsuko should join the Nine Soldiers, but her and Luke are at odds. Natsuko tries to figure out a way back home, but then remembers what happens next in "A Tale of Perishing" and realizes everyone's in danger again.

Episodes.Title: DESTINY
Episodes.Description: The Last Town has their Harvest Festival and the Nine Soldiers get some time off. That's where Luke meets Destiny. In "A Tale of Perishing," the two fall in love, but Natsuko coming into the this world seems to be throwing off that destiny...

Episodes.Title: ETERNITY
Episodes.Description: Natsuko notices that Memmeln is acting strange. In the movie, there is a scene with Memmeln that's a mystery even to fans, so Natsuko tails her...

Episodes.Title: JUSTICE
Episodes.Description: Destiny asks the Nine Soldiers to bring food to some orphans and they run into a former Nine Soldier, Justice.

Episodes.Title: CHANGE
Episodes.Description: Natsuko loses to the Voids for the first time, but still tries to continue her selfish actions.

Episodes.Title: FIRST LOVE
Episodes.Description: Natsuko tries to figure out exactly what first love feels like for her upcoming film.

Episodes.Title: CONFESSION
Episodes.Description: Luke finally tells Natsuko how he really feels about her.

Episodes.Title: HERO
Episodes.Description: Luke thinks about his life as the legendary hero.

Episodes.Title: CHAOS
Episodes.Description: Rumors start to spread about Natsuko which leads the people of the Last Town to turn on her.

Episodes.Title: DESPAIR
Episodes.Description: Luke suffers more loss and falls into despair while Memmeln comes up with a certain plan with Meg and Sally.

Episodes.Title: ZENSHU
Episodes.Description: Natsuko has to draw one final thing to save the Last Town from its greatest threat.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of the Public Bathhouse
Episodes.Description: A vampire works in a bathhouse in hopes of drinking the virgin blood of its heir Rihito, who worryingly falls in love on his first day of high school.

Episodes.Title: The Unpleasant Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru worries he has inadvertently made Aoi interested in Rihito. Rihito chats with Aoi the next day after school, but they soon get into trouble.

Episodes.Title: Franken and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After saving Aoi, a hungry Ranmaru tries to resist the urge to feed on her. Rihito soon arrives at the scene and comes to a mistaken realization.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire's Slumber Party
Episodes.Description: Franken proclaims his admiration for Ranmaru, who tasks him with protecting Rihito. Franken tags along with them back to the Tatsuno house for dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of Fate
Episodes.Description: Rihito's teacher Sakamoto — an undercover vampire hunter of notable lineage — learns that his longtime foe Ranmaru lives with the Tatsunos.

Episodes.Title: Love, the Cross, and the Vampire

Episodes.Title: And Thus, A New Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru asks Rihito's father to let Nagayoshi stay in the apartment behind the bathhouse. A newly inspired Nagayoshi declares he's in love with Kaoru.

Episodes.Description: Nakamura Teruaki has moved south to Okinawa from Tokyo and fallen in love with a local girl. There's just one problem, though: her Okinawan dialect is so thick that he can't understand a word she says!
