Episodes.Title: The Red Gundam
Episodes.Description: Amate Yuzuriha, a high-school girl living in the Izuma colony, meets a female courier named Nyaan.

Episodes.Title: The White Gundam
Episodes.Description: Char, an ace pilot of the Principality of Zeon forces, captures the Earth Federation's latest mobile suit Gundam, a key component to their "Operation V," at Side7. From that moment, the tide of war shifts dramatically, ultimately leading to Principality of Zeon’s victory in the One Year War. However, just before the end of the war, Gundam and Char...

Episodes.Title: Machu in Clan Battle
Episodes.Description: Amate meets a boy named Shuji, who pilots the Red Gundam. She can’t forget the sensation of the glowing universe they experienced together and suggests forming a MAV to enter the Clan Battle. Amate decides to use the entry name "MACHU."

Episodes.Title: The Witch's War
Episodes.Description: A super unicum known as the "Witch," who shot down over 100 enemies during the One Year War, enters the Clan Battle to settle an old score with the Red Gundam. Seeing this Witch, who clings to mobile suit combat even at the cost of abandoning her husband and child, Machu witnesses the depths of human obsession.

Episodes.Title: Nyaan Doesn't Know About Kira-Kira
Episodes.Description: Machu plans to earn money in the Clan Battle and travel to Earth with Shuji and Nyaan. However, on the day of the Clan Battle, Machu is caught by Xavier. At this rate, the trip to Earth will remain just a dream. At that moment, Nyaan…

Episodes.Title: The Plot to Assassinate Kycilia
Episodes.Description: Annqi discovers Shuji’s hideout. Information about the Red Gundam is worth more than any Clan Battle prize money. Machu finds out that Annqi schemes to sell that intel during the Clan Battle. Earth Federation forces’ intelligence agency finds out about Kycilia’s top secret information decides to…

Episodes.Title: Machu's Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of Annqi's plan, Machu devises a plan with Nyaan to use the Clan Battle as a means to help Shuji escape. However, their opponent in the next Clan Battle turns out to be a newly built mobile armor operated by terrorists aiming to assassinate Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: Falling on the Moon
Episodes.Description: In the final stages of the One Year War, the Sodon Fleet led by Char launched to stop the Earth Federation forces' operation to drop Solomon Fortress; to protect the lunar city of Granada. Five years later in Granada. Nyaan was there with Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: The Rose of Sharon
Episodes.Description: Guided by a mysterious message, Machu escapes Sodon and descends alone to Earth in GQuuuuuuX. After crash-landing to Earth, she is rescued by a woman adored as “lady,” who is being held captive in the Kabas estate. Machu decides to escape with her and attempts to flee in the Core Fighter.

Episodes.Title: Yomagn'tho Blockade
Episodes.Description: To stop Yomagn'tho from causing destruction, Machu takes on a mission from Challia Bull to rescue the girl of rose. However, Kycilia makes her move first. Nyaan’s mobile suit, the GFreD, begins activating the Zeknova cannon. Its target: all of humanity on Earth—

Episodes.Title: Alphacide
Episodes.Description: Machu's GQuuuuuuX fights against Nyaan's GFreD as she tries to rescue the girl of rose. Eventually, guided by Shuji, Machu ventures alone into the heart of Yomagn'tho. There, she meets Char and Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: That's Why I...
Episodes.Description: This is the end game. A white mobile suit appears from the other side, attempting to kill Lalah. To Machu’s shock, the pilot of this White Devil is none other than Shuji. Determined to protect Lalah, Machu becomes a MAV with Nyaan and decides to fight Shuji.

Entries.Title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express
Entries.Description:
Freshly arrested, Chiharu and Makina are sentenced to scrub the Milky☆Subway.

It was supposed to be simple.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard!
Episodes.Description:
Freshly arrested, Chiharu and Makina are sentenced to scrub the Milky☆Subway.

It was supposed to be simple.

Episodes.Title: False Departure
Episodes.Description:
As part of their rehab program, Chiharu and Makina board the train for cleanup duty.

They’re joined by four reluctant misfits who clearly didn’t sign up for what’s coming.

Episodes.Title: Chiharu and Makina
Episodes.Description:
The Milky☆Subway launches without warning, six convicts aboard.

Flashback to the beginning: during interrogation, cracks start to show in Chiharu and Makina—and Officer Ryoko begins connecting the dots.

Episodes.Title: Eat, Fight, Repeat
Episodes.Description:
Chiharu and Makina head for the front car to stop the runaway train—only to crash into biker duo Akane and Kanata.

Forced to team up (awkward), they press on… straight into what appears to be a dining car?

Episodes.Title: HAIJO-KUN
Episodes.Description:
Now with Akane and Kanata on board, the crew pushes forward.

But a sketchy security bot blocks the way—and it’s not in the mood to negotiate.

Episodes.Title: Kurt and Max
Episodes.Description:
Flashback again: just hours before launch, cyborgs Kurt and Max are interrogated by Officer Ryoko.

Something’s off. But what?

Episodes.Title: Labor and Reward
Episodes.Description:
The gang struggles to get past the rogue security bot.

Their only hope? Kurt and Max.

Too bad those two are deeply allergic to teamwork.

Episodes.Title: Tempura Shrimp Tail
Episodes.Description: With Kurt and Max finally joining in, the six misfits charge ahead—only to be stopped cold by an unexpected bathroom break.

Episodes.Title: Delusion and Panic
Episodes.Description: A system glitch traps everyone in the train's bathroom. Chiharu gets stuck in the women's bathroom door, while Kanata, Kurt, and Max launch a daring escape plan.

Episodes.Title: Akane and Kanata
Episodes.Description:
Still trapped in the train’s bathroom, the team’s fate rests in Kanata’s hands.

Can he save the others—and maybe earn the trust of Akane, who once called him “a tempura shrimp tail”?

Episodes.Description: Satsuki and An use a makeshift drone to try some photography when they receive notice that the photography club will be dissolved due to the lack of members. Troubled by this news, they invite fellow classmate Sakurako Shikishima from the Cinema Club, which has also received a dissolution notice. Meanwhile, Haruno is stuck on her manga draft when her high school friend, Kako Komada, pays her a visit. The two hit the road for a tour.

Episodes.Title: Right Before It Becomes an Anime!! The Manga Pilgrimage Stamp Rally with a Schedule from Hell!
Episodes.Description: Haruno gets word of a manga that will be adapted into an anime. As she lives in the real-life location of that manga's story, she scouts out locations and decides to make it a focus for her manga creations. Haruno tries to carry out her plan to visit these manga pilgrimage sites on an ambitious schedule, but the other members of the Cinephoto Club can't seem to hide their unease. And so begins the hellish schedule of this location scouting tour....

Episodes.Title: A Comfy Manga Artist Goes on a Winery Tour - Motovlog Part 13 / Taking Pictures of Food and Getting Full Until We Explode
Episodes.Description: Haruno invites Satsuki and the rest to join an event where they take pictures and eat while walking. The three girls happily accept, thinking it's the perfect event for the Cinephoto Club, but they find out they'll be going around shops that serve generous portions of food to the point they'll be full! They're disappointed in the food brought to them, but this is just the beginning of their fight.

Episodes.Title: The Story of Dry-Cured Ham in Yamanashi / A Haunted Spot and Incident of Possession
Episodes.Description: The dry-cured ham that Haruno was looking forward to enjoying ended up being used as one of the recipe's ingredients! With a little convincing from Kako, the group heads out to buy some famous Yatsugatake ham instead. While on the road, they drop by abandoned places and ski areas here and there, enjoying some Kiyosato curry and visiting a variety of stores that sell ham.

Episodes.Title: Taking the Perfect Picture of a Maruishi Dosojin in Yamanashi! / We'll Enjoy Some Curry in Yamanashi
Episodes.Description: As a story idea for Haruno's manga, the girls participate in a "maruishi" hunting event in the prefecture.

Episodes.Title: First Time for an Anime Adaptation / Calling All Manga Artists! Minobu Walker
Episodes.Description: One of Haruno's manga artist friends, Isuzu, gets her work selected to be adapted into an anime! Worried about the money involved and how busy she'll be, she confides in Kurokuma and Haruno about how uneasy she feels about everything. The girls worry for Isuzu and, as a change of pace, participate in the Minobu Donburi Walk together.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The First Night)
Episodes.Description: Haruno and the Cinephoto Club head to Nagano for a two-night-three-day trip for a scoop. While everyone raises their hand to suggest places they want to go to, An says she wants to film some skateboarding downhill with an action camera. To do this, though, they'll need someone to ride the skateboard with her....

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Second Night)
Episodes.Description: The girls meet up and head over to Kurobe Dam, where they watch a documentary about the dam's construction.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Third Night)
Episodes.Description: It's the last day, and the group has gone all over Nagano to get this scoop. The group arrives at Togakushi, Nagano, where they try making fresh soba. They break into two teams: adults and children, and have a competition to make some soba! And finally, the group makes their last stop at a Ninja Trick Mansion, but what exactly awaits them there?

Episodes.Title: Enjoying All the Spots on the Yamanashi Shaved Ice Map
Episodes.Description: There are only two days left of summer vacation. As Cinephoto Club reflects upon this past summer, they realize they haven't eaten shaved ice yet! To make this the best summer vacation without any regrets, the group takes one last trip to enjoy all the shaved ice spots listed on the Yamanashi Shaved Iced Map.

Episodes.Title: POV Horror - What ever shall we do?
Episodes.Description: The Cinephoto Club begins shooting a horror film, though not everything is as it seems.

Entries.Title: Winx Club: The Magic is Back
Entries.Description: Bloom discovers she has magical powers on her 16th birthday, after a scary encounter with a magic creature. She is rescued by Stella and Flora, two fairies from Alfea School for Fairies and Witches.

Episodes.Title: A New Fairy in Alfea
Episodes.Description: Bloom discovers she has magical powers on her 16th birthday, after a scary encounter with a magic creature. She is rescued by Stella and Flora, two fairies from Alfea School for Fairies and Witches.

Episodes.Title: Which Fairy is Witch?
Episodes.Description: Bloom is torn when she learns she must take a test at Alfea to determine whether she is a fairy or a witch. The Trix take advantage of her doubts, pushing Bloom closer to despair.

Episodes.Title: Winx v Trix
Episodes.Description: When Stella's ring mysteriously disappears, the Winx embarks on a risky mission to retrieve it from Cloud Tower. As they explore the school's eerie tunnel, Bloom faces a powerful awakening.

Episodes.Title: A Trick by the Trix
Episodes.Description: The Winx face their toughest physical exam yet, pushing their magic and teamwork to the limits. Meanwhile, Bloom attempts to bond with the mysterious Damien.

Episodes.Title: The Shopping Trip
Episodes.Description: The Winx plan a day of adventure in Magixia, but Griselda's strict restrictions and an incomplete project keep them grounded... until Robin helps them sneak away.

Entries.Title: StuGo
Entries.Description: MUTANT MISCHIEF! The kids must face the Mutant thieves who stole their food.

Episodes.Title: Dog Eat Dog
Episodes.Description: MUTANT MISCHIEF! The kids must face the Mutant thieves who stole their food.

Episodes.Title: Legitimate Summer Camp
Episodes.Description: SWEET SUMMER SCIENCE! The kids arrive at Lullah's mysterious summer camp and attempt to fix her laser.

Episodes.Title: The Nannytee
Episodes.Description: OH THE HU-NANNYTEE! Lullah wants alone time and creates a Manatee-Nanny to watch the kids.

Episodes.Title: Noodle It (A Little Bit)
Episodes.Description: LIZARD LOVIN' LARRY! Pliny must choose - support Larry's noodling habit or keep him safe.

Episodes.Title: Diorama Drama
Episodes.Description: FIENDISH FIGURINES! Pliny tries to keep a promise when the kids play with a strange diorama.

Episodes.Title: Goat Racket
Episodes.Description: CRIME AND BEANS! Sara feels guilt after conning Larry out of his collectible beans.

Episodes.Title: Breakfast at Chippany's
Episodes.Description: CHIP BREAKFAST-HANDS! Chip wants to make a breakfast that will blow his friends' socks off.

Episodes.Title: Birdyguard
Episodes.Description: HERPETOLOGICAL HIJINKS! Larry saves a baby lizard and swears to protect it from harm.

Episodes.Title: No Manhands Is an Island
Episodes.Description: MARITIME MUTATION! Chip tries committing to the ways of survivalist Nils Vulfen.

Episodes.Title: Sister Swim
Episodes.Description: PERTURBING PORPOISE! When the kids encounter a dolphin, everyone is excited - except Merian.

Episodes.Title: Moon Moon
Episodes.Description: RESENTFUL ROBOTS! Lullah sends Sara to stop a rover from drawing a dirty rear on the moon.

Episodes.Title: Mailbog
Episodes.Description: DIRE DISPATCH! Francis goes on a quest to deliver a letter.

Episodes.Title: Finder's Kelpers
Episodes.Description: KELP-TOMANIA! Pliny and the Kelp Folk try to beat Lullah at her own game.

Episodes.Title: Truck Everlasting
Episodes.Description: NACHO NOSTALGIA! Mr. Okay worries Lullah is going to replace him.

Episodes.Title: Alpha Betta Chip
Episodes.Description: FISHY FISTICUFFS! Chip is forced to use slap-based tactics to defend a bullied mutant.

Episodes.Title: The Bomb Swapper
Episodes.Description: BLUFF GO BOOM! The kids’ prank accidentally lures one of Lullah’s nemeses to the island.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf of Jealousy
Episodes.Description: GOLD-RIDDEN GUILT! Larry must confront his jealousy - or be consumed by it!

Episodes.Title: Stench Mensch
Episodes.Description: OFF-PUTTING PUDDING! To keep a secret, Lullah is forced to help Pliny assist a pathetic grub.

Episodes.Title: Francis Wants to Be Alone
Episodes.Description: FRAGILE FRIENDSHIPS! A spiraling Merian tries to figure out exactly why Francis left her party.

Episodes.Title: The Sash
Episodes.Description: PRESIDENTIAL PANDEMONIUM! The kids vie for a presidential sash.

Episodes.Title: Deep Trent
Episodes.Description: ASININE ASSIGNMENTS! Merian tries to save Dr. Lullah's fish counter from a life of busy work.

Episodes.Title: Disaster Play
Episodes.Description: A PLAY TO SAVE THE DAY! The kids put on a play to warn mutants about a disaster.

Episodes.Title: Shapesister
Episodes.Description: SNEAKY SECRETS! The kids have to face their deepest fears to retrieve their lost ball.

Episodes.Title: Lullah's Game
Episodes.Description: HAND VS. HAND! Lullah tricks the kids into playing a devious game.

Episodes.Title: Night Mutants
Episodes.Description: MIDNIGHT MUTINY! Larry wants to see what the island's nightlife has to offer.

Episodes.Title: Chunk Beastknuckles
Episodes.Description: CHIP MODS HIS BOD! Chip wants his rival to see him as a tough, apex predator worthy of being hunted.

Episodes.Title: The Leg Farm
Episodes.Description: LEAPIN LEGS! Merian is sent to a special place to learn how to relax.

Episodes.Title: Unquenchable Thurst
Episodes.Description: NICE TO PEAT YOU! Pliny dislodges a naturalist from a bog and joins him on a journey of discovery.

Episodes.Title: Plantcis
Episodes.Description: CHLOROPHYLL-AINS! Francis has to protect a plant from a nefarious threat.

Episodes.Title: Big Ol' Heads Egg Salad Venture
Episodes.Description: EGGS-ISTENTIAL CRISIS! Merian struggles to open an egg salad stand with Pliny.

Episodes.Title: PANTelevision
Episodes.Description: MUTANT TV! The kids get sucked into a white-hot, Mutant soap opera.

Episodes.Title: Infinity Braid
Episodes.Description: FOLLICULAR FOLLY! Sara attempts to nail the perfect hairstyle so she can be the star of Francis' painting.

Episodes.Title: Primate Fear
Episodes.Description: COURTROOM CRISIS! Merian takes on the case of a destructive space chimp.

Episodes.Title: Francis' Last Straw
Episodes.Description: HIGH-STAKES HAGGLING! Pliny wants to play "Geoplomacy" when the kids discover six sandbars.

Episodes.Title: Phishin' Chip
Episodes.Description: SECRET AGENT NINCOMPOOP! Chip becomes a spy to prove he's not a nincompoop.

Episodes.Title: Shell-Shock!
Episodes.Description: SAVE YOURSHELLF! After a close call, daredevil Larry embraces a life of extreme caution.

Episodes.Title: Elephant Triumvirate Book 6: Trunkumvirate Triumphaphant
Episodes.Description: ELE-FAN-FIC-TASTIC! Sara lies in order to join the kids' "Elephant Triumvirate" book club.

Episodes.Title: Z.O.R.B.Z. (Zorbular Orb Rorb Borb Zorbs)
Episodes.Description: ZORBZ RORB THE BORB! Larry asks Mr. Okay to help unlock the true power of his dud Zorb.

Episodes.Title: Pea-Brained Mutant Crystal Nuptials
Episodes.Description: SEVEN COURSES OF CHAOS! A Mutant trio sets out to discover the purpose of some weird-shaped berries.

Episodes.Title: S.T.U.G.O.
Episodes.Description: SIX SUCKERS! A new visitor offers the kids the summer of their dreams.

Entries.Title: Dog Days Out
Entries.Description: Holm and Button pretend to be squirrel-fighting superheroes. A game of golf goes off course when the ball goes missing. A pigeon eats too much dog food.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Dog / Messy Golf / To Fly Again
Episodes.Description: Holm and Button pretend to be squirrel-fighting superheroes. A game of golf goes off course when the ball goes missing. A pigeon eats too much dog food.

Episodes.Title: Doggy Kart Race / The Baby-Sitters / Turkey Rush
Episodes.Description: The dogs and toys rev up to race around the neighborhood. Sneaky squirrels plot to swipe Holm's snack. Momo's ball hides inside a delicious turkey.

Episodes.Title: Protect the Sausage Tree / Banana Figure Skating / Dancing King or Queen
Episodes.Description: Holm plants sausages in the ground to try and grow more. Slippery banana peels turn the street into a skating rink. The dog friends have a dance battle.

Episodes.Title: The Birthday Gift / The Golden Treasure Hunt / Soccer Day
Episodes.Description: A pigeon steals a special present. Holm and Button follow a treasure map and find a surprise. A soccer match brings out the pups' competitive sides.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Frisbee / The Missing Bucket List / Stormy Roller Coaster
Episodes.Description: The dogs and their pals have a frisbee catching contest. Someone snatches Holm's bucket list bone. A storm shakes up Holm and Button's camping plans.

Episodes.Title: A Sleepless Night / Bubble Town / Catch That Ghost
Episodes.Description: Janggoon's snoring ruins Holm and Button's sleep. A floating fart bubble threatens to stink up the neighborhood. Holm and Button host a Halloween party.

Episodes.Title: Stick Together / Escaping the Heat / Bath Time Is No Fun
Episodes.Description: A bubble gum balloon goes "pop!" The dogs fight over a block of ice during a heatwave. Victoria and D5 team up to give Holm and Button a bath.

Episodes.Title: Burger Bedlam / The Disastrous Date / Moving Tree House
Episodes.Description: Momo tries to get his paws on a spicy hamburger. Holm goes on a date with Wari — but he can't stop farting! Holm and Button's tree house rolls away.

Entries.Title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
Entries.Description: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

Episodes.Title: Become My Closet
Episodes.Description: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

Episodes.Title: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.
Episodes.Description: It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best
Episodes.Description: Shirota learns how much effort Takamine has put in to be who she is. Later she helps him get first place.

Episodes.Title: Don't Be Dense, Be Sharp.
Episodes.Description: When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.
Episodes.Description: Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.

Episodes.Title: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota roleplay newly-weds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.

Episodes.Title: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.

Episodes.Title: You Two Seem Quite Intimate
Episodes.Description: Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Do It!!
Episodes.Description: Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?

Episodes.Title: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up
Episodes.Description: The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?

Episodes.Title: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run
Episodes.Description: To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?

Episodes.Title: Only Look At Me
Episodes.Description: Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!

Entries.Title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
Entries.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: The 99-Legged Bug
Episodes.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: Rampage of the Fox Demon
Episodes.Description: Nueno uses his ultimate weapon Demon Hand to exorcise the Yokai possessing Hiroshi. But suddenly, the mysterious and handsome Tamamo appears, kidnapping Hiroshi right before Nueno's eyes! As Nueno gives chase, Tamamo makes preparations throughout town for an unknown ritual. Just why did he kidnap Hiroshi, and what is his true identity?

Episodes.Title: The Midnight Honor Student
Episodes.Description: An unsettling shadow appears in the school in the dead of night. It's rumored that an honor student is erasing blackboards, replacing flowers of flower vases, and cleaning the rabbit cages when there should be no one there. To get to the truth of the matter, Hiroshi and his friends sneak into the school, only to encounter a voice in the dark saying, "Let's be friends!"

Episodes.Title: The Rokurokubi
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Nueno's amazing power, Miki becomes obsessed with gaining psychic abilities. She even tries to train while sleeping. When her efforts produce an unusual result, she joyfully celebrates her success. However, her friends are far from impressed. In fact, they are scared of what Miki has become.

Episodes.Title: Hatamonba's Curse
Episodes.Description: Katsuya will do anything to make his sister Manami happy, even if it means he has to run around borrowing money. That is how he unwittingly falls victim to the evil spirit Hatamonba's trap. When he realizes Hatemonba's deadly blade is not only pointing at his own neck, but also his sister's, he runs to Nueno for help. However, Hatamonba's sword appears to be mightier than Nueno's Demon Hand.

Episodes.Title: The Teketeke Ghost
Episodes.Description: Fear grips Makoto after he hears about Teketeke, the spirit of a girl who lost her lower body in a railway accident. According to the story, now she wanders the world in search of new legs. Makoto grows desperate for help upon learning that the spirit is coming for him within three days. However, Nueno urges him to forget everything, insisting that Teketeke is nothing more than a myth.

Episodes.Title: The Unseasonable Yuki-onna
Episodes.Description: As unseasonable snow blankets the town of Domori, a beautiful young woman appears before Nueno. Her name is Yukime, and she has come to fulfill a promise she made to him five years ago. Excited by their teacher's improbable romance, Nueno's students sneakily tag along on their date, only to witness Yukime's frosty intentions.

Episodes.Title: Great Inventions and Spirit World Communicators
Episodes.Description: Young inventor Akira finds a broken tablet and becomes even more obsessed with building great machines, as if he is possessed by something. One day, Akira announces he can bring the dead back to life, scaring his friends. Nueno senses something is wrong and investigates Akira's inventions, when he notices something strange within Akira's tablet...

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Brings Happiness
Episodes.Description: One day, Nube meets a little girl in town. She is a Zashiki Warashi, a spirit that brings good fortune to people. The Zashiki Warashi becomes attached to Nube and follows him to school. From that day on, unexpected good fortune begins to befall his classmates one after another. However, as he sees how the students in his class gradually forget about hard work and start relying on good fortune, Nube finds it difficult to say goodbye to the Zashiki Warashi, but...

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Food for the Soul
Entries.Description: University student Mako Kawai lives a quiet life. Then one day, she's unexpectedly invited to join a club.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Food Culture Research Club
Episodes.Description: University student Mako Kawai lives a quiet life. Then one day, she's unexpectedly invited to join a club.

Episodes.Title: I Might Want to Cook
Episodes.Description: Mako and the others are told they must hold an activity to show what their club is about or be disbanded!

Episodes.Title: My Money's Gone!
Episodes.Description: Mako and the others decide to go out together on the weekend, but then Shinon's money for the trip disappears!

Episodes.Title: This Is Nana Hoshi
Episodes.Description: Mako accidentally bumps into a scary girl after German class. Later, that same girl shows up at the club room!

Episodes.Title: Want to Go for a Drive?
Episodes.Description: Kurea and Shinon get their licenses, so the club decides to go for a drive... but they end up on the freeway!

Episodes.Title: Could It Be I’ve Gained Some Weight?
Episodes.Description: The club goes out for a day of shopping. When Mako tries on a skirt, she's shocked to find it doesn't fit!

Episodes.Title: I Don't Think I'll Ever Forget
Episodes.Description: The club trip begins! After the train and sightseeing, they plan to use the outdoor oven. But then, it rains!

Episodes.Title: The Air Conditioner Is... Broken?
Episodes.Description: Nana spots her escaped pet in the worst location. Then, one hot day, the club's air conditioner won't turn on!

Episodes.Title: Let's Try Running a Stall!
Episodes.Description: The club decides to have a food stall at the university fair, which means Nana will have to help customers!

Episodes.Title: I'm Home
Episodes.Description: The club takes a trip to Mako and Shinon's hometown. Mako is nervous about meeting her old friends again.

Episodes.Title: Are You Free for Christmas?
Episodes.Description: Three of the club members study late and get locked in the building! Later, the club plans a Christmas party.

Episodes.Title: Thanks for the Feast!
Episodes.Description: The club gathers to give their clubroom a New Year's cleaning. They reminisce and enter the new year together!

Entries.Title: Once Upon a Witch's Death
Entries.Description: Apprentice witch Meg Raspberry is told she will die in a year unless she collects one thousand tears of joy.

Episodes.Title: The Witch with One Year to Live
Episodes.Description: Apprentice witch Meg Raspberry is told she will die in a year unless she collects one thousand tears of joy.

Episodes.Title: The Apprentice Witch and the People of Lapis
Episodes.Description: Meg's friend Fine requests her help with fixing a watch.

Episodes.Title: Wisdom Visits From the East
Episodes.Description: Meg is visited by Inori, the Witch of Wisdom, while Faust is away on business.

Episodes.Title: Blessings With the Opening of the Gate
Episodes.Description: Meg helps Sophie, the Witch of Blessings and one of the Seven Sages, open the gate at the Otherworld Festival.

Episodes.Title: Flowers Bloom in the Festival Night Sky
Episodes.Description: While preparing for the parade, Meg and Sophie meet Marie, a woman looking for the man she met a year ago.

Episodes.Title: An Evening Sky Without Magic
Episodes.Description: Meg brags to Faust about how easy it has become to collect tears and is forbidden from using magic.

Episodes.Title: Words and Disasters and Ceremonies
Episodes.Description: Meg attends a special magic ceremony held once every 20 years.

Episodes.Title: The Family Bewitched by a Devil
Episodes.Description: Meg sees a burn-like scar on a girl's neck that is only visible to her.

Episodes.Title: The Old Giant Tree Sleeps
Episodes.Description: The sacred tree of Lapis has become polluted by magic and must be removed to prevent further damage.

Episodes.Title: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part One)
Episodes.Description: Meg and Inori visit Aquamarine, a resort destination with a cutting-edge medical facility.

Episodes.Title: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part Two)
Episodes.Description: Meg and Jack experience a breakthrough in their research, and a massive disaster threatens the entire island.

Episodes.Title: The People I Love
Episodes.Description: Meg has mysterious nightmares about a lone witch floating above a destroyed city.

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

Episodes.Title: Just Desserts
Episodes.Description: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

Episodes.Title: Strong Assault
Episodes.Description: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

Episodes.Title: Round and Round the Tower
Episodes.Description: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.

Episodes.Title: Slice Slice Dance
Episodes.Description: While X and Gaku invade the JAA, a lone ORDER assassin stands in their way. Amid the chaos, Sakamoto discovers the shocking truth about X's identity.

Episodes.Title: Have a Nice Flight
Episodes.Description: After facing Takamura, X and his men temporarily retreat from the devastated JAA Kanto Branch and begin a new plan. Meanwhile, Sakamoto learns that X is his former JCC classmate, Uzuki. Advised by Hyo, Sakamoto and Shin board a plane to take the JCC transfer exam and search for clues in the JCC data bank.

Episodes.Title: Kanaguri
Episodes.Description: It's every assassin for themselves as the exam takes to the skies. While Sakamoto impresses fellow candidate Akira, Shin takes on the germaphobe Mafuyu.

Episodes.Title: Exam, Stage Three
Episodes.Description: Stage Three of the JCC exams begins as a trio of special applicants joins the fray. Toramaru, a devoted Sakamoto fan, immediately clashes with Shin.

Episodes.Title: Mutual Fans
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto discovers Akira's ties to an old friend. While Shin and Toramaru vie over their favorite assassin, X's secret plans throw the exam into chaos.

Entries.Title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger
Entries.Description: Taiga from the elementary division joins Rena and the others at Mihama Academy Class A. Chris gets named as her higher officer, and she asks Haruto, the handler for the reason. What does Chris think as she carries Taiga on her back after a hard workout?

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle I
Episodes.Description: Taiga from the elementary division joins Rena and the others at Mihama Academy Class A. Chris gets named as her higher officer, and she asks Haruto, the handler for the reason. What does Chris think as she carries Taiga on her back after a hard workout?

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle II
Episodes.Description: A terrorist attack transpires at the medical university Taiga visited. The perpetrators are members of a new religious group seeking to obtain a virus to be used for bioterrorism. The United Nations decides to conduct an air strike to prevent the virus from spreading worldwide. Receiving the news, Class A was ordered to stay put. However, Chris ignores the order to rescue Taiga on her own.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle III
Episodes.Description: Chris fights the terrorists with explosives but gets shot. Class A heads to the scene after receiving a warning. Class A's operation begins.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Blade I
Episodes.Description: Murasaki's sister, Yuuki, returns to Class A. Rena is annoyed with her, and Murasaki doesn't seem herself. What happened to the sisters in their past?

Episodes.Title: Phantom Blade II
Episodes.Description: Several years before, Haruto visited Yuuki's village to learn "Phantom Blade." One day, the village got ambushed, and Murasaki suspected Haruto.

Episodes.Title: Bluest Blue I
Episodes.Description: Haruto was born by an experiment. He was raised by Ichiru, Nogami, and Aoi Aoi, a group of assassins. Let us look into how "Haruto Aoi" came about.

Episodes.Title: Bluest Blue II
Episodes.Description: Phantom Trigger got a mission to destroy a religious group. Who awaited the team was a very familiar face.

Episodes.Title: Arisaka's Journal
Episodes.Description: Arisaka must decide on Class A's overseas deployment request. Enishi and Chloe awaits Class A.

Episodes.Title: Rite of Passage
Episodes.Description: All SORD forces are called upon. Haruto encounters Chloe. He points his sword to his archenemy who killed Aoi.

Episodes.Title: Heaven's Door
Episodes.Description: Patrick and Bruno meet a group of young Sisters in a dugout. We just want to live...

Episodes.Title: The Right Choice
Episodes.Description: As members of Mihama Academy fight their own battles, former Phantom Trigger makes a big decision.

Episodes.Title: The Fated Answer
Episodes.Description: All SORD forces except Class A retreat. Rena is remembering the time when she was picked up by Haruto.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Children
Episodes.Description: The battle is coming to an end. This is the story of Phantom Trigger drenched in blood and smoke.

Entries.Title: Let's Go Karaoke!
Entries.Description: Okada Satoshi, a third-year middle school student and the head of the choir club, is suddenly approached by a yakuza named Narita Kyoji at the choir competition venue, who says, "Let's go sing karaoke!" I'm called out to. At the Matsuribayashi gang, where Kyoji is, there's an annual karaoke contest, and the request was for singing lessons so he wouldn't be crowned the worst singer.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Change! / Get on My Level, Friggin' Noob

Episodes.Title: I Want to Be the Noble Maiden / It Lets You Dance All Over Them
Episodes.Description: As Lilisa strives to become a refined lady for her mother's sake, she unexpectedly encounters a former student who has been honored with the title of Noble Maiden.

Episodes.Title: I Will Bow Out of Playing / We'll Prove We're the Best!
Episodes.Description: Lilisa and the others gear up for their final shot to rock the Live House, resolved to take down the boy band Bacchus.

Episodes.Title: Rock Lady

Entries.Title: Übel Blatt
Entries.Description: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

Episodes.Title: Durch Bruch (Break Through)
Episodes.Description: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

Episodes.Title: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
Episodes.Description: During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

Episodes.Title: Langer Regen (The Long Rain)
Episodes.Description: When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

Episodes.Title: Köinzell
Episodes.Description: Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

Episodes.Title: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
Episodes.Description: Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the defenses of the castle.Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

Episodes.Title: Schtemwölech
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairyblood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

Episodes.Title: Der leere Sarg (The Empty Coffin)
Episodes.Description: A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watch the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

Episodes.Title: Der Heldmörder (The Hero-Killer)
Episodes.Description: In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

Episodes.Title: Junge Blätter (Young Leaves)
Episodes.Description: At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

Episodes.Title: Gegenangriff (Counterattack)
Episodes.Description: Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolks of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

Episodes.Title: Gefühl zu… (With Feeling)
Episodes.Description: As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

Episodes.Title: Neues Schwert (New Sword)
Episodes.Description: Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault.

Entries.Title: 9-nine- Ruler's Crown
Entries.Description: During a town revitalization event at the White Snake Tsukumo Shrine, a sudden earthquake occurs. Sho Shinkai witnesses the destruction of a sacred artifact in the main hall of the shrine and injures his finger on a fragment he picked up. This was a sign of a quiet and strange occurrence. A few days later, rumors spread that a stone statue of a girl had appeared in the park. In response to this mysterious occurrence, Sho goes to investigate the rumor with his classmates Yoichi Fukazawa and Miyako Kujo to see if it is true. Is it a coincidence or fate? The "story" quietly begins to move.

Kujo Miyako, who seems to know something, offers to help Sho. As Sho and Miyako search for the cause of the fire, a supernatural being with the ability to freely control flames appears before them. Facing a threat that cannot be countered by common sense, Miyako activates her powers using an accessory called an "Artifact," which bestows special abilities. As danger looms, the two join forces to face the supernatural being. What fate awaits them at the end of the battle?

Episodes.Title: Branch 03

The two of them build a strong bond through their investigation. However, Yuki Kia, who is pursuing the culprit of the petrification incident alone, appears and begins to suspect that Sho may be the culprit.

Episodes.Description: Morihito Otogi is a teenager with ogre strength. His childhood friend, Nico, is coming home after completing her witch training! Following an old pact, they begin living together. Can Morihito protect the clumsy Nico from a dire prophecy?

Entries.Description: Marie absolutely adores her younger brother Shion, everything from the way he secretly plays pretend to the oddly grown-up look he gets sometimes. One day, he asks their father about something called "magic" and their whole lives change.

Episodes.Title: Marie and Shion
Episodes.Description: Marie absolutely adores her younger brother Shion, everything from the way he secretly plays pretend to the oddly grown-up look he gets sometimes. One day, he asks their father about something called "magic" and their whole lives change.

Episodes.Title: There Is No Magic in This Other World
Episodes.Description: After yearning for magic throughout his first life, Shion lives his second life in another world without magic. But his sister's discovery at a lake has given him hope. As he researches the luminous phenomenon, he feels his dream stir back to life.

Episodes.Title: Goblin Attack
Episodes.Description: Goblins are sighted near the village. Gawain goes to hunt them while Shion and others from the village hide in the mansion for protection. Suddenly, there's a pounding at the door and a window shatters—a goblin has broken into the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Magical Research Begins in Earnest
Episodes.Description: Shion's father finally approves of his magic research, which leads Shion to a new discovery. Marie seems troubled as she devotes herself to her sword.

Episodes.Title: Lightning Ore and Bolt

Episodes.Title: Guild and Monster Suppression
Episodes.Description: Left shaken by his father's words, Shion continues his research by taking it into the field to hunt monsters.

Episodes.Title: Daily Life Begins to Break Down
Episodes.Description: Two years after Shion and the others' first monster hunt, a mysterious red light flashes through the clouds.

Episodes.Title: I Will Do the Healing
Episodes.Description: Marie is gravely ill and strange monsters have attacked. Shion is determined to do everything he can to help.

Episodes.Title: Lethargy Sickness ~Treatment and Research~
Episodes.Description: Shion devotes himself to finding a cure for lethargy sickness. Rose, worried for her friends, offers to help.

Episodes.Title: The Night Menace Has Come
Episodes.Description: The night menace appears once more. Shion and the others race out to defend Istria from horde of wraiths.

Episodes.Title: Sorcery and Magic
Episodes.Description: Ainswelf's arrival changes everything. Shion steps up to challenge a foe far more powerful than himself.

Episodes.Title: Who Am I Really?
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from the battle, Shion sleeps for a week. He wakes to concerned faces and a mysterious phenomenon.

Entries.Title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless...
Entries.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: First Kiss?! No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description:
The showdown between Renako and Mai has begun: best friend or girlfriend?

Mai visits Renako as a “friend,” and they have a blast. Friendship is the best!  But Mai’s feelings keep growing. Hoping to prove friendship wins, Renako plans a fun weekend outing. Everything's going great… until a sudden downpour flips everything on its head!?

Episodes.Title: You Can't Freaking Force Me!
Episodes.Description:
Renako tries to forget the kiss, while Mai leaves for work in Paris. Renako walks home with Ajisai after school, holding hands and making plans to hang out later, too. Mai calls her a cheater, but they're not even dating, so how can she be?!

But then when Ajisai comes over, Mai shows up too, bringing her little sister Haruna. Now it’s a chaotic four-person hangout... What could possibly go wrong?

Episodes.Title: Mai?! No Freaking Way! (...Or Maybe?)
Episodes.Description: Mai skips school, and Renako starts to worry... Maybe she really went too far. But then Satsuki calls her in to reveal the truth. Turns out, a heartbroken Mai told her something crazy... She's planning to join a Suitors Party?! How did it come to this?! Renako rushes to the hotel venue, where she and Mai face off… in swimsuits. Now’s the time. Renako has to finally tell Mai how she really feels!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way! (Round 2)
Episodes.Description: Satsuki suddenly drops a bomb: “Let’s be girlfriends.”  It’s clearly revenge for Mai's careless treatment of her. Still, Renako agrees to play along for two weeks if it helps the two make up.  But why does Ajisai seem bothered? No way… right? Meanwhile, Mai’s as calm as ever. Things are shifting with Satsuki, but is it really headed in the right direction?

Episodes.Title: Too Many Freaking Secrets!
Episodes.Description:
Satsuki suddenly starts acting all couple-y in front of Mai, much to Renako's confusion. After seeing an unexpected side of Satsuki, Renako dares to admit she's actually an introvert, only to find out Satsuki already knew. Shocked, Renako runs off, but Satsuki finds her, and somehow she ends up spending the night at Satsuki’s place.

Are they really taking a bath together too!?

Wait, why!?

Episodes.Title: No Freaking Way I’m Surviving This Mess!
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Ajisai-san, Mai finally agrees to talk with Satsuki, and Renako gets roped in as a witness. Just when it seems like they’ll make up, Satsuki drops a secret photo of her and Renako! Wait, what?! Things spiral out of control and somehow it’s turned into an FPS showdown??! There’s no way Renako's losing… absolutely no way…!

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Win? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After their FPS practice, Renako stays the night at Satsuki’s. “Thanks for letting me face Mai,” Satsuki smiles, making Renako wish they’d just make up already. The long-awaited showdown begins! Mai’s flawless aim, Renako’s sharp instincts… and Satsuki struggling to keep up. But Renako can’t let her lose without a fight!

Episodes.Title: Visiting Ajisai’s House? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After the troubles with Satsuki settle down, Renako visits Ajisai over summer break... Only to realize that behind her gentle smile are hidden struggles. When Ajisai suddenly declares she’s running away, Renako decides to join her. Their destination: a hot spring! A fleeting summer escape that brings the two closer than ever.

Episodes.Description: The club members decide on what category they will each compete in at the Kyoto NHK Cup preliminaries, recitation or announcing. Toga will not enter in either.

Episodes.Title: Big Sister and Little Brother
Episodes.Description: It’s a tight deadline, but the broadcasting club has the will to complete their submission to the original TV drama category.

Episodes.Title: Satisfaction and Unfinished
Episodes.Description: Shura is an expert storyteller, and her ability to conjure an entire city in her audience’s mind proves that Hana still has a long way to go.

Episodes.Title: Matching Charms and a Falling-Out
Episodes.Description: Hana makes new friends during a recitation workshop. Little does she know that one of them has a connection to Anne's past.

Episodes.Title: Orange Blossoms and Resolve
Episodes.Description: What's the best way to improve one's skills? There are many answers, but no single best path.

Episodes.Title: Friends and Family
Episodes.Description: A wedding invitation, a surprising discovery, and an unexpected complication threaten to derail the Broadcasting Club's hard work just before the preliminaries.

Episodes.Title: Hana and Shura
Episodes.Description: The Club may have concocted a clever plan to reach Mizuki, but one formidable final boss stands in their way: Mayumi Usurai, Mizuki’s grandmother.

Entries.Title: #1 Happy Family USA
Entries.Description: Hello, I am Hussein, and this is my family, the Husseins! This is a very big day for us. We have experienced a loss… but I negotiated a very cheap burial price! Go me. Tomorrow is already looking better!

Episodes.Title: NINE TEN
Episodes.Description: Hello, I am Hussein, and this is my family, the Husseins! This is a very big day for us. We have experienced a loss… but I negotiated a very cheap burial price! Go me. Tomorrow is already looking better!

Episodes.Title: #1 VIGIL MOURNERS!
Episodes.Description: Look how many candles we have! We are the most sad AND the least scary! There is nothing hidden in my halal cart. Trust us. Now.

Episodes.Title: WE ARE NOTHING!
Episodes.Description: The government has created a new secret spy program called See Something Say Something! But you can't see something if we are nothing!

Episodes.Title: EGYPT IS ON THE PHONE!
Episodes.Description: Mona, this is a very important phone call. We are speaking to our relatives in Egypt. This is a very expensive call, but of course I got us a phone card that is very cheap. It is very important that you make our move across the world seem worth it. Make us look good! Now.

Episodes.Title: VERY GOOD HATE CRIME!
Episodes.Description: Hateful, but helpful. The best hate crime I have ever seen. I love this country.

Episodes.Title: DAUGHTER PRESIDENT!
Episodes.Description: The school election is just as important as the presidential election and only one of them is rigged. Soon my daughter will run the world! While my son wastes away. Inshallah.

Episodes.Title: INSHALLAH PUBES!
Episodes.Description: Rumi, once they grow down there, they leave your head. I’m sorry son. It’s time for you to grow up. You will be a bald man by high school.

Episodes.Title: A SLEEPOVER WITH MR. PRESIDENT!
Episodes.Description: We love you Mr. Bush. Feel free to stay at our house, and torture our family. We cannot wait to visit this Guantanamo Bay! It sounds beautiful.

Entries.Title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
Entries.Description: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Capital
Episodes.Description: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Is Astounded by a Wizard
Episodes.Description: Allucia reminisces about her training with Beryl, and her resolve to have him instruct the knights hardens. While taking in the city sights with Curuni, Beryl meets up with Ficelle, another former student. She surprises him with her magic. But another wizard gives him even more of a surprise!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Weathers a Fierce Attack
Episodes.Description: Former student and top-ranking adventurer Surena enlists Beryl’s help to train new adventurers. At the Adventurer’s Guild, Beryl ends up in a duel with her to prove he has what it takes for the job. He isn’t really happy with the turn of events, but Surena seems to feel differently.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes Flight With a Monster
Episodes.Description: To protect the new adventurers, Beryl faces off against a dangerous monster. Unlike other opponents, it acts on instinct, and he’s drawn into a ferocious battle, unable to get a read on its moves. Later on, he faces an encounter that will turn his future upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Enraged by the Bad Guys
Episodes.Description: Beryl encounters a pickpocket. Seeing the despair in her eyes, he confronts her in an attempt to get her to open up, but it’s not as easy as he thinks. With the help of Allucia and Lucy, he strives to help her free herself from the clutches of shadowy forces and the evil that binds her.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces the Dead
Episodes.Description: Someone is controlling the lowlifes taking advantage of Mewi behind the scenes. Religion and international relations come to the forefront, and with no ties that might cause an international incident, Beryl is asked to flush out the mastermind. New sword in hand, Beryl battles for Mewi’s future.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Learns the Challenges of Parenting
Episodes.Description: Beryl and Mewi start living in the house Lucy gave Beryl. Although unsure, Beryl works on becoming a parent figure for Mewi. When they find out that the magic institute Mewi is enrolled at has a student dormitory, Beryl wonders whether it is best for her to live with him, or on campus.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Struck by a Lightning-Fast Sword
Episodes.Description: When a delegation from a neighboring country arrives, Allucia asks Beryl to help guard the VIPs, and he can’t refuse. Beryl needs the right clothes for the job, so he and Allucia go shopping. It’s just like a date! The next day, Allucia approaches Beryl with an offer.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes on His First Hunt in Ages
Episodes.Description: Mewi needs a new bag for school, so Beryl goes shopping. But he quickly realizes just how expensive bags can be! A job offer from Surena provides a means to make some extra cash, and he jumps at the chance. But he soon realizes – this job is one even high-ranking adventurers have never completed!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Guards a Princess
Episodes.Description: The Vice Commander of the Holy Order of the Church of Sphene is Beryl’s former student, Rose, and he renews his ties with her. When the delegation arrives, Beryl is assigned to guard the two royal families as they tour the capital. But a shadow looms over what is supposed to be a joyous event.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Throws Himself into a Deadly Fight
Episodes.Description: Beryl helps protect the royal family from assassins, but the assassins all kill themselves, and any clues to the mastermind are lost. Lucy thinks a conflict between royalty and religion is at play. Despite Beryl wanting to cancel the tour of the capital to keep the prince safe, the plan goes ahead.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Praised as a Master Swordsman
Episodes.Description: It was Rose behind the flood of assassins. Beryl confronts her in an effort to find where her true intentions lie. Rose tells him, and the two draw their swords against each other. What will the outcome be in this battle between master and student?

Dedicated to ensuring the success of their next stage performance, Sakiko pours her all into creating the perfect stage. However, discord arises among members dissatisfied with the band's direction.

Episodes.Title: Sub rosa.
Episodes.Description: Under the leadership of the founder Sakiko, Ave Mujica's popularity and reputation are thriving. Dedicated to ensuring the success of their next stage performance, Sakiko pours her all into creating the perfect stage. However, discord arises among members dissatisfied with the band's direction.

Episodes.Title: Exitus acta probat.
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Nyamu's scheme, the members of Ave Mujica had their masks removed on stage.

Episodes.Title: Quid faciam?
Episodes.Description: Mutsumi's mental exhaustion takes its toll, and she makes a mistake during the live performance. Sachiko's quick reaction helps resolve the situation, but the impact it had on the audience will pose a problem for the future of Ave Mujica.

Episodes.Title: Acta est fabula.
Episodes.Description: Ave Mujica continues to develop thanks to Mutsumi. There is no trace of the previous discord, and all its members are in harmony.

Episodes.Title: Facta fugis, facienda petis.
Episodes.Description: The band disbands in the middle of their national tour. The members of Ave Mujica each return to their own lives.

Episodes.Title: Animum reges.
Episodes.Description: Mortis clings onto Soyo and attempts to enlist her help in order to wake up Mutsumi, who has fallen into a deep slumber. Just how will the MyGO!!!!! members react to seeing "Mutsumi", who has completely changed from her previous self...?

Episodes.Title: Post nubila Phoebus.
Episodes.Description: The MyGO!!!!! members have finally learnt the truth behind CRYCHIC's disbandment. Sakiko's broken words of not knowing who Mutsumi, Ave Mujica nor CRYCHIC are incite reactions from the former CRYCHIC members, to the point where they can no longer just stay still...

Episodes.Title: Belua multorum es capitums.
Episodes.Description: The ordinary girls have at last bid farewell to the place they called home. Upon witnessing CRYCHIC's performance, Umiri, consumed by a burning jealousy, takes it upon herself to revive Ave Mujica.

Episodes.Title: Ne vivam si abis.
Episodes.Description: Umiri schemes, Mortis clings to her, Nyamu crashes due to her current situation, and Uika is filled to the brim with agony. As a result, everyone's hidden motives become entangled...

Episodes.Title: Odi et amo.
Episodes.Description:
"I want to dedicate my whole life to you."

Powerful words, but are they empty?

Episodes.Title: Te ustus amem.
Episodes.Description: What we are about to show you is the story of a girl with a secret.

Episodes.Title: Fluctuat nec mergitur.
Episodes.Description: As fate surges before her like a raging storm, all that remains in her struggling hands is...

Episodes.Title: Per aspera ad astra.
Episodes.Description: The path they have traveled, the scenery of where they are now. "The seasons have changed..."

Entries.Title: Lazarus
Entries.Description: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye Cruel World
Episodes.Description: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Life in the Fast Lane
Episodes.Description: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.

Episodes.Title: Long Way from Home
Episodes.Description: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.

Episodes.Title: Don't Stop the Dance
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Pretty Vacant
Episodes.Description: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.

Episodes.Title: Heaven Is a Place on Earth
Episodes.Description: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.

Episodes.Title: Almost Blue
Episodes.Description: Coordinates from an AI lead to islands that Skinner bought just before they sunk under rising sea levels. The team visit them hoping to learn more.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Fire
Episodes.Description: Chris is held captive on an arctic oil rig by Russian operatives. The team unites to save her, despite learning Chris was once a Russian spy herself.

Episodes.Title: Death on Two Legs
Episodes.Description: An inquiry is held at the Pentagon to determine the future of Lazarus where information emerges that prompts Schneider of INSCOM to hire an assassin.

Episodes.Title: I Can't Tell You Why
Episodes.Description: Skinner's medical history provides a lead but requires entry to a private clinic. Leland takes Axel and Doug to his home to secure them an invite.

Episodes.Title: Runnin' with the Devil
Episodes.Description: Doug and Eleina go to Islamabad seeking the elusive hacker but are pursued by INSCOM. Meanwhile, Axel gets into a chaotic fight with the assassin.

Episodes.Title: Close to the Edge
Episodes.Description: Eleina gets a lead to Skinner from Popcorn Wizard, but with Hersch, Axel, and Doug out of commission, it's up to Chris and Leland to crack the case.

Episodes.Title: The World Is Yours
Episodes.Description: Abel conducts a raid to free Hersch, while Axel sneaks off to face his nemesis. The rest of the team pursues Skinner in a final bid to save humanity.

Episodes.Title: The Night It All Began
Episodes.Description: Jack and his friends rush to attend a momentous celebration, blissfully unaware of the looming revolt that threatens to turn his world upside down.

Episodes.Title: A Fateful Day
Episodes.Description: After the attack, Jack wakes up in a hospital to find the city in ruins. He rushes home to find answers, but authorities suddenly pay him a visit.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Face
Episodes.Description: One year later, the VC3 squad lands on the Moon to execute its mission. Meanwhile, the Moon Chains rebel forces begin a takeover of Copernicus City.

Episodes.Title: What Matters Most
Episodes.Description: A devastating tragedy stirs memories of his grueling journey with the rest of the VC3 squad, reminding Jack of an important conversation with Eric.

Episodes.Title: Revelation

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: As the squad struggles with the relentless attacks, Jack tries to wrap his mind around the fateful encounter. Can he trust Phil after all this time?

Episodes.Title: People of the Moon
Episodes.Description: Windy infiltrates the Goddard Base. Meanwhile, with Mary as their guide, the squad learns how the Earth-Moon conflict has impacted the moon people.

Episodes.Title: Mary
Episodes.Description: Phil recollects a dark memory when Dr. Salamandra arrives with urgent news. At Delambre Station, Mary shares her past with Jack when Rhys interrupts.

Episodes.Title: Unchanging Feelings
Episodes.Description: Inanna falls mysteriously ill, and while Mary knows someone who can cure her, they're in the opposite direction. Will the squad make the detour?

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: The squad finally arrives at Agarum City but faces a blockade. Hoping to reduce the number of casualties, Jack takes matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Unknown
Episodes.Description: Dr. Salamandra abandons her fight with Jack to stop a rampaging L-Zone. They struggle to subdue the entity — until Mary suddenly appears.

Episodes.Title: Falling Shadows
Episodes.Description: As the rogue L-Zone advances toward Agarum City, the squad grapples with the discovery of Mary's mysterious quality. Later, the base is compromised.

Episodes.Title: Parting
Episodes.Description: While the battle between the rebel forces and the Joint Army rages on, Jack faces Rhys in a painful confrontation. Mary makes a desperate request of him.

Episodes.Title: The Past and Reality
Episodes.Description: Thirteen years ago, Rhys meets Jack for the first time. In the present, the VC3 squad plunges into a fierce battle zone to reach their target.

Episodes.Title: Expectations
Episodes.Description: Time is running out for Rhys and her team, but an unforeseen reunion disrupts their mission. Later, Mary and Jack reflect on everything that's happened.

Episodes.Title: Reminiscence
Episodes.Description: Phil recounts the day he learned the truth about everything and shares shocking information about Jack's true purpose. Dr. Salamandra interrogates Rhys.

Episodes.Title: Domination
Episodes.Description: While the L-Zone surrounds Copernicus City, Zowan and Duan free Rhys. In a clash with rebel forces, Inanna and the squad face a tough decision.

Episodes.Title: Carry On Your Will
Episodes.Description: Following a deadly scuffle, the L-Zone begins to act up and absorbs Mary in the chaos. Can Phil and Jack save her and the Moon before it's too late?

When they went to the woods behind the dorm, they found Cyril losing control of his mana and slowly spreading ice around and freezing himself, too. Monica identifies the reason behind the mana rampage and finds out that there’s a culprit behind it. The hidden secret of the student council gets unveiled.

Episodes.Title: The Adventure of the Silent Witch
Episodes.Description: It's the weekend and Monica is freed from her duty, so she decides to go to the city of Craeme with Nero.

Episodes.Title: A Cup Out of Place
Episodes.Description: Serendia Academy is a distinguished academy dedicated to nurturing refined ladies and gentlemen, so girls are required to take ballroom dancing and tea party classes. Since Monica lived in isolation in a mountain cabin for a long time, she must re-take her ballroom dance test. Monica was already struggling, and to make matters worse, the tea party announcement was made. Her group is Monica’s friends Lana Colette and Casey Grove, as well as Claudia who is an intelligent woman known as the “walking library.” How will the tea party and Monica’s re-examination for the ballroom dance go?

Episodes.Title: A Jealous Noblewoman
Episodes.Description: The ballroom dance re-examination test is over, so Monica is having a barbecue with Glenn and the others.

Episodes.Title: My Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Monica is attending school for the first time in a week, so Lana and Casey hold a welcome back party for her. Claudia also joins and the girls have fun. Everyone is curious about the school festival that’s right around the corner. Casey is going to sell her embroideries at the charity bazaar, and Monica’s eyes light up when she sees them, so Casey promises to make one for Monica, too. That same day after school, supplies are delivered to the school, so Monica heads to the storage with Cyril. Casey fills in for the stage designer and accompanies them, but…

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Secret
Episodes.Description: The assassination plot against the second prince by Spiralflame was thwarted by Monica the Silent Witch.

Entries.Title: Cute High Earth Defense Club Hi-CARA!
Entries.Description:
Once upon a time, there was a hero who protected the Earth from a great crisis... And now, in the face of another crisis, a new hero is born from Binan High School's "Earth Defense Club"! ...Huh? Who were those former heroes? Well, it was "those guys", "those guys". ...Huh? Why are you blurring out the names? It's a multi-verse setting, so mumble mumble... (vague)　

Anyway, the new defense department - Unzen Shinkuro, Sukayu Narushi, Unohana Sousuke, Oshamanbe Ushio and Aso Akuta.

Episodes.Title: Romantic Revolution Hi-CARA!
Episodes.Description:
Once upon a time, there was a hero who protected the Earth from a great crisis... And now, in the face of another crisis, a new hero is born from Binan High School's "Earth Defense Club"! ...Huh? Who were those former heroes? Well, it was "those guys", "those guys". ...Huh? Why are you blurring out the names? It's a multi-verse setting, so mumble mumble... (vague)　

Anyway, the new defense department - Unzen Shinkuro, Sukayu Narushi, Unohana Sousuke, Oshamanbe Ushio and Aso Akuta.

Episodes.Title: Algae Is HI-CARA!
Episodes.Description: With the help of the feline science of the mysterious future cat Nuru, the five members of the Defense Club have become the "Hi-CARA Romantic Squad" and successfully defeated the monsters plotting to take over the Earth. Then, before them appears the "Ban-CARA Avant Guard Corps", an Earth Conquest Club led by the mysterious prairie dog Master Kyan. Their true identities are none other than Doumeki Straight, Nyutou Samon and Nekoma Tasuku, roommates at the Kurotama Dorm and members of the Binan High School Student Council. With lies and enemies under the same roof, it's impossible for something not to happen... right?

Entries.Title: Sword of the Demon Hunter
Entries.Description: It is 1840, year 1 of Japan's Tenpo era. There lies a small village known as Kadono that is home to the siblings Jinta and Suzune. Jinta is quickly dispatched to slay demons.

Episodes.Title: Demons and Humans
Episodes.Description: It is 1840, year 1 of Japan's Tenpo era. There lies a small village known as Kadono that is home to the siblings Jinta and Suzune. Jinta is quickly dispatched to slay demons.

Episodes.Title: The Demon's Daughter
Episodes.Description: Jinta changes his name to Jinya and departs Kadono. Ten years pass and he is now a ronin living in Edo, well-known by the locals as "the demon slayer."

Episodes.Title: The Devourer (1)
Episodes.Description: Three years have passed from the Nihonbashi incident. Jinya hears talk of street killings occurring near a soba shop. The number of dead don't match the number of missing.

Episodes.Title: The Devourer (2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Natsu get attacked by the slasher thought to be a demon. After Mosuke arrives to help and Jinya brandishes his blade, the demon quickly vanishes into the darkness.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Happiness (1)
Episodes.Description: In the fall of 1853, a samurai by the name of Naotsugu Miura grows concerned about his missing brother. However, everyone insists that he doesn't have a brother.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Happiness (2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Naotsugu witness a young girl losing her parents in a fire, which brings the unexpected truth of the mystery to light.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Night of Kudanzaka
Episodes.Description: In the winter of 1853, Jinya is hired by Jyuuzou to investigate a demonic painting known as "the Ukiyo-e of Kudanzaka" that's said to be cursed.

Episodes.Title: Blossoming Dreams of the Kanzashi (1)
Episodes.Description: In the spring of 1854, rumors spread of a demon woman who kills men in the Yoshiwara redlight district. Jinya investigates.

Episodes.Title: Blossoming Dreams of the Kanzashi (2)
Episodes.Description: A man named Somegorou Akitsu gifts Natsu a hairpin then crosses paths with Jinya. Somegorou's spirit dogs attack Jinya and he must use his demon powers to defend himself.

Episodes.Title: Harlot in the Rain
Episodes.Description: In May of 1855, Naotsugu and a woman in a kimono catch sight of a man in the distance who looks different to both. Naotsugu sees his brother and the woman sees an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (1)
Episodes.Description: In winter of 1856, Zenji brings a liquor to the soba shop and it becomes immensely popular. However, Jinya finds something unsavory about it.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (2)
Episodes.Description: A series of violent incidents occur across Edo, all related to Yuki-no-Nagori. Worse yet, rumors of a woman with blonde hair send chills down Jinya's spine.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (3)
Episodes.Description: It turns out Yuki-no-Nagori is an evil drink. Jinya finds a demon calling out the name "Jinta". As they face off, Jinya suffers from the weakness of his own heart.

Episodes.Title: Embodiment of Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Back in the winter of 1839, when Jinya was still just Jinta, there were rumors of strange phenomena occurring near the Modori River. Byakuya orders Jinta to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Late Night Tales of Demonic Swords ~Hijin~
Episodes.Description: The year is 1862. The arrival of the Perry Expedition in Japan brings unrest into the cities. Jinya hears about a cursed sword called the "Yatonomori Kaneomi."

Episodes.Title: Logic of the Amanojaku
Episodes.Description: In July of 1863, Jinya hears rumors of a demon in Mizuho temple that devours humans. Upon visiting, Jinya comes across a silver-haired fox demon.

Episodes.Title: By the Sword
Episodes.Description: In March of 1864, a job comes to Jinya to slay a demon named Okada. Okada has become a crazed murderer willing to kill anyone from fellow samurai to women and children.

Episodes.Title: A Chat Over Tea
Episodes.Description: In September of 1867, Somegoro Akitsu leaves Kyoto with a tea set that he takes to Jinya. Akitsu wants to find someone who can use the set to conduct a tea ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Change
Episodes.Description: Jinya and his daughter, Nomari, enjoy peaceful days staying with Naotsugu and his family. However, time changes all things and their world faces a drastic transformation.

Episodes.Title: Wish (Part 1)
Episodes.Description: While engaged in a fierce battle with Tsuchiura, Jinya is forced to take on his demonic form, witnessed by both Naotsugu and Nomari.

Episodes.Title: Wish (Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Tsuchiura face off during a heavy rainstorm. When Jinya's demon arm begins to throb, it sparks a resonance that allows them to experience each other's pasts.
