Entries.Title: Bullet Bullet
Entries.Description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed, and the world has become a wasteland. Despite their poverty, the people use remnants of past civilizations to lead resilient lives. Gear works in a junk shop while also retrieving stolen goods alongside the robot Qu-0213 and White Bear, a gambler.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Horizon
Episodes.Description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed, and the world has become a wasteland. Despite their poverty, the people use remnants of past civilizations to lead resilient lives. Gear works in a junk shop while also retrieving stolen goods alongside the robot Qu-0213 and White Bear, a gambler.

Episodes.Title: You Decided to Do It
Episodes.Description: The city is abuzz with the news that a grand theft has been carried out by Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213. On the run from the police, the three culprits return to the junk shop, only to fail to receive their reward.

Episodes.Title: I Learned Not to Trust People
Episodes.Description: With one assassin after another hot on their trail, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 find themselves fleeing from intense pursuit. They cannot get hold of Noah, and their beloved car, Bullet, is running dangerously low on gas. The trio must quickly devise a plan to escape the mess they are in.

Episodes.Title: We Are Your Family
Episodes.Description: Reunited safely with Noah, the trio hands over the requested item, only to find that it is not what Noah wanted at all. The real treasure is a completely different item.

Episodes.Title: You Fool
Episodes.Description: Gear is left crushed by a sense of helplessness after Noah is kidnapped. Gear stumbles across a Gotcha spinoff titled, "The Escape Story of the Great Villain Road." Watching the unstoppable determination of the hero stirs something within Gear, reigniting his resolve.

Episodes.Title: You Have the Right to Know
Episodes.Description: After Gear, Qu-0213, and Noah are arrested by the capital's police and separated from White Bear, they are taken underground, facing imminent execution. However, at the last moment, their restraints are mysteriously removed.

Episodes.Title: Time to Get to Work
Episodes.Description: Shaken with sorrow and anger after learning the truth, Gear and his friends decide to collaborate with the Resistance, determined to expose the government's secret to the world. As the day of the operation approaches, they work tirelessly to prepare for the challenges that loom on the horizon.

Episodes.Title: The World Is Much Bigger, Tougher, and Uglier
Episodes.Description: Gear and his team race to escape with the top-secret government data they have stolen, but Barrel blocks their path, announcing that their plan has already failed. Gear, driven by an unshakeable determination to change the world, refuses to give up.

Episodes.Title: That Guy Is Like Spinach Stuck in Your Teeth
Episodes.Description: Captured by the National Security Agency, Gear, White Bear and Qu-0213 are imprisoned in an extremely cold and desolate facility. Stripped of their freedom, each of the three is forced to confront their personal struggles and the harsh realities of their situation.

Episodes.Title: I Have Discovered a Way Only I Can Change the World
Episodes.Description: Following their failed escape attempt, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 are imprisoned on a secluded island surrounded only by the sea. As they adapt to life behind bars, they unexpectedly cross paths with the assassin Cook siblings.

Episodes.Title: Do Not Stop Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Gear and his comrades, joined by the assassins and the Resistance, race toward the capital at full speed. However, their path is blocked by the government’s autonomous security system. To make matters worse, the capital’s police forces launch an assault from both the ground and the skies.

Episodes.Title: Bullet/Bullet
Episodes.Description: After a fierce struggle, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 finally reach the deepest part of the capital’s underground. To destroy the core of the system, they head through a door, eventually arriving in a pitch-black space. A spotlight flickers on, revealing a mysterious figure.

Episodes.Description: Watari Naoto and his sister Suzu try to live a normal life. His destructive childhood friend Satsuki returns.

Episodes.Title: Small Lies
Episodes.Description: The plants in the garden are beginning to sprout. But so are the small lies that everybody employs.

Episodes.Title: Worldly Desires, Begone
Episodes.Description: Ishihara-san has the image that Naoto is a perfect, kind, chaste saint. Can he kill all his desires, though?

Episodes.Title: Showing and Being Seen
Episodes.Description: Everyone is going to the beach. Satsuki and Ishihara get bathing suits. What will Naoto say to them?

Episodes.Title: Ideal Partner
Episodes.Description: On their walk, Naoto and Ishihara run into Fujioka, her "ex-boyfriend". What really happened between them?

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: After overcoming multiple obstacles, Ishihara finally confesses her feelings to Naoto. What is his response?

Episodes.Title: After School, Just Before Summer Break
Episodes.Description: Ishihara and Naoto go on a date at the zoo, albeit with Suzu in tow.

Episodes.Title: A Cute Junior
Episodes.Description: At a part-time job interview, Naoto meets Umezawa Makina, a junior from middle school and the ace of the track and field club. When Makina finds out that Naoto doesn't have a smartphone, she forcefully takes him to buy one, but once he gets the phone, the first person he calls is Murasaki. Makina, who went on to join the track and field club at a prestigious girls' high school in Tokyo, has actually fallen into a slump and has been skipping club activities. Seeing that Naoto seems happy, unlike her, Makina plots to make him break up with her and become her toy to kill time...

Episodes.Title: The Fireworks
Episodes.Description: Makina, who is showing off to her club members by saying she is going to the fireworks festival with her boyfriend, asks Naoto to play the role of her boyfriend. Naoto recommends Tokui for the role and makes an arrangement to meet Murasaki, who is going with some local friends, on the way. On the day of the fireworks festival, Naoto and Murasaki sneak out of the festival midway and head home as it starts to rain. Soon, the downpour begins to pour, and the two seek shelter at Naoto's house, where they find Satsuki, who has come to take care of her vegetable garden out of concern for it. Everyone is soaked, and the three of them end up staying at the house for the night, but...

It is then that a terrible piece of news will turn his life upside down.

Episodes.Title: A Mysterious Man
Episodes.Description: After failing at the Mathematics Olympiad and giving up on his dream of becoming a mathematician, Gaku Kitada meets Kai Asakura, a young genius chef, through a plate of spaghetti Napolitan he prepared at the school cafeteria. It is then that a terrible piece of news will turn his life upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Door of Truth

Episodes.Title: Challenge Gods With Cooking
Episodes.Description: Gaku unexpectedly reunites with Kagura Musashi, his childhood friend and former Math Olympiad rival. Disappointed by his decision to leave math behind, she scoffs—until he serves her a dish crafted through logical precision.

Episodes.Title: Before and After
Episodes.Description: Realizing that the path of cooking leads to the "Gate of Truth," Takeru takes the hand of Umi, who boasts that he will "challenge God with cooking." After graduating from school at the top of his class, Takeru moves to Tokyo and begins living with Umi as an apprentice chef at "K." Umi, who has noticed Takeru's fatal weakness, puts him in charge of the meals at "K" and gives him the task of creating meals that will satisfy all the staff within a week. Takeru enters "K" kitchen in high spirits, but is horrified by the harshness of the battlefield.

Entries.Title: Bogus Skill «Fruitmaster» ~About that time I became able to eat unlimited numbers of Skill Fruits (that kill you)~
Entries.Description: Light, who dreams of becoming an adventurer, eats a skill fruit in order to gain a special ability. However, he acquires the bogus skill "Fruitmaster," which is completely unsuited to combat. Eating a second skill fruit results in death. Unable to try again, Light resigns himself to becoming a fruit farmer. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Lena gains the "Sword Saint" skill and debuts as an adventurer. One night, Light accidentally eats a second skill fruit, but...

Episodes.Title: The Only Ingredient
Episodes.Description: Light, who dreams of becoming an adventurer, eats a skill fruit in order to gain a special ability. However, he acquires the bogus skill "Fruitmaster," which is completely unsuited to combat. Eating a second skill fruit results in death. Unable to try again, Light resigns himself to becoming a fruit farmer. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Lena gains the "Sword Saint" skill and debuts as an adventurer. One night, Light accidentally eats a second skill fruit, but...

Episodes.Title: Incomplete Light
Episodes.Description: Light becomes an adventurer and is reunited with Lena, now a rank S adventurer, at the guild. However, she acts coldly towards him, and Light is bewildered. The truth is the direction and thinking of Lena's party does not match her own, and she suffers every day. When Light learns about their cruelty, he decides to rescue Lena and have her join his party.

Episodes.Title: The Magic Castle of Spirits
Episodes.Description: Light, Lena, and Ayla are hired by the guild to figure out why some adventurers went missing and find them. When they arrive at the count's manor that is their one lead, they encounter adventurers who have been turned into undead. The three of them fight as they head deeper into the manor, where they find Dratena, who uses the "Necromancy" skill, waiting for them.

Episodes.Title: Taboo Skills
Episodes.Description: The members of Luxeria defeat the undead controlled by Dratena's "Necromany" skill one after another. The battle grows even more intense with the appearances of the now undead Count of Montes and a Soul Reaper, a monster that turns living humans into undead. During the battle, Light learns of the existence of widely-hated "taboo skills."

Episodes.Title: A Tumultuous Argument
Episodes.Description: While Light rests after collapsing, Lena and Ayla are called to the adventurer's guild to report to the guild's authorities on the incident with the Wicked Dragon. They attempt to get information on "Black Swan" and Dratena, but the Holy Sister cleverly dodges their questions, so Lena offers the Wicked Dragon's scale in exchange for access to records concerning Dratena.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Blacksmith
Episodes.Description: Light and Ayla visit the Tradesman's District in search of a blacksmith who will make Light a powerful sword. They're directed to the Bolst Workshop, but on their way there, they come across a girl being pursued by a violent group of men.

Episodes.Title: The Thundering Beast
Episodes.Description: Light has successfully rescued Monica from her kidnappers, but Zamdo proves to be a formidable opponent.

Episodes.Title: The Indomitable Torch Flame
Episodes.Description: For Light to have a chance of beating Zamdo in combat, Monica must make him a sword, but can she get it done in time?

Episodes.Title: The Reunion By the Lake
Episodes.Description: While looking for Dratena in the city of Athena, Lena encounters Flower Hat and her subordinate Yuan.

Episodes.Title: Waves of Frenzy
Episodes.Description: Lena and Dratena must work together to stop the monsters being summoned by the strange mist.

Episodes.Title: Blessing of the Fairies
Episodes.Description: Lena unexpectedly gains the ability to defeat both Argos and the Wicked Dragon.

Episodes.Title: The Evening Star
Episodes.Description: After defeating Argos and the Wicked Dragon, Lena and her companions speak with a mirage of the Fairy King.

Episodes.Title: First Drink: "Career Change Night"
Episodes.Description: Sekiguchi (later Hajime) was feeling depressed after a lot of things happened at work, so he transferred to a host club called "Club One." The club was staffed by unique hosts from another dimension!

Episodes.Title: Second Drink: "Sexuality"
Episodes.Description: Hajime tries to get through conversations with just "I see" and "That's true" while serving customers. To learn how to please customers with more than just talking skills, he decides to talk to the number 3 host, Senichi, who is a tough guy.

Episodes.Title: Third Drink: "Symbol Of Friendship"
Episodes.Description: Hajime's salary is low, but the number two host, Ryoichi, notices this and offers to buy him a meal, and the two hit it off.

Episodes.Title: Fourth Drink: "Hajime's Choice"
Episodes.Description: Hajime is troubled by a customer's advances. He is forced to make a decision about the after-hours services the host will provide.

Episodes.Title: Fifth Drink: "Two Warriors"
Episodes.Description: Senichi has lost his number one spot in the social game score rankings. In order to spin the gacha, he gulps down champagne in his own way.

Episodes.Title: 6th Drink: "Koichi's Past"
Episodes.Description: Koichi can revive infinitely even if he vomits. Rumor has it that before going independent as Club One, he worked at the legendary host club "Trillion".

Episodes.Title: 7th Drink: "Makeup Master"
Episodes.Description: Hajime doesn't have any regular customers. He wonders if he should change his appearance, so he decides to watch a makeup video by a famous Osaka host to learn more.

Episodes.Title: 8th Drink: "Stop Fighting"
Episodes.Description: Ryoichi's original lighter for business purposes has gone missing. Ryoichi claims that Senichi stole it, but...

Episodes.Title: 9th Drink: "Guest From the West"
Episodes.Description: Osaka host Okonomiya Taro and Sauce Nishioka come to Club One. Koichi is asked why he quit Trillion.

Episodes.Title: 10th Drink: "Firestarter"
Episodes.Description: When a host approaches him on the street, Senichi tells him he is "Number 3 of Trillion" and silences him. If he keeps calling himself Number 3 of Trillion everywhere, he will get into trouble.

Episodes.Title: The First 1,225 Steps
Episodes.Description: Manga artist Suzugamori Chika goes on a journey guided by poll results. Her first destination: Aizuwakamatsu.

Episodes.Title: The Real Deal! A Lively Journey for Two
Episodes.Description: Chika visits Matsushima alone and feels a little lonely. Koyomi joins her journey to Kurobe in Toyama.

Episodes.Title: Perfect the Way It Is
Episodes.Description: Chika and her junior Yui go on their first journey together to Takamatsu, Kagawa, in the Shikoku region.

Episodes.Title: Smile by the Sea
Episodes.Description: Chika travels to Kyoto with manga artists Fuyune and Riri and gets inspired by their creative process.

Episodes.Title: Crows, Dragons, Soba, and a Remote Island
Episodes.Description: Chika journeys to Tochigi alone and then to Awashima with Koyomi.

Episodes.Title: An Epic Midsummer Journey!
Episodes.Description: Chika's Awashima journey with Koyomi ends, and Yui joins for "The Epic Summer Journey: Tokyo Arc."

Episodes.Title: A City Where You Can Meet Gods? And Then...
Episodes.Description: Chika visits the Ise Shrine with Riri. Then, Yoshimoto sends her off on a night bus trip with Yui and Fuyune.

Episodes.Title: Three Girls, Cozy and Full of Laughs
Episodes.Description: Chika explores Hiroshima with Fuyune and Yui. She then produces a draft that gets approved by her editor.

Episodes.Title: Completion at the Hot Spring, Then the First Sunrise
Episodes.Description: Chika goes on a solo journey to Aomori and then to Wakayama to see the first sunrise of the year.

Episodes.Title: Home in My Heart
Episodes.Description: After Chika returns from her solo journey in Wakayama, Koyomi joins her for a journey to Hanamaki in Iwate.

Episodes.Title: A Pilgrimage with Master

Episodes.Title: That's Journey
Episodes.Description: Riri makes a surprise appearance, inspiring Chika. Yoshimoto offers Chika a shot to get her one-off published.

Entries.Title: I Left My A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
Entries.Description: Yuke, a red mage, quits his A-rank party, Thunder Pike, because he feels they don't appreciate the support he provides. While seeking a new party, he encounters one of his former students, Marina, who invites him to join her new D-rank party.

Episodes.Title: Clover Is Born
Episodes.Description: Yuke, a red mage, quits his A-rank party, Thunder Pike, because he feels they don't appreciate the support he provides. While seeking a new party, he encounters one of his former students, Marina, who invites him to join her new D-rank party.

Episodes.Title: The Forest Where a Magic Beast Dwells
Episodes.Description: Clover's first stream has drawn a lot of attention, so they accept another quest in a forest that's been taken over by a magic beast.

Episodes.Title: Overflow
Episodes.Description: Clover's success in slaying the Zarnag draws more attention to them—and draws Thunder Pike's attention back to Yuke.

Episodes.Title: Shadow Stalker
Episodes.Description: Clover accepts a quest to help promote an armor workshop's latest line of adventuring gear.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Clover goes house-hunting, and Simon tries to bring Yuke back by offering to grant his lifelong dream.

Episodes.Title: Achromatic Darkness
Episodes.Description: Clover begins its investigation of Achromatic Darkness... and already trouble is brewing.

Episodes.Title: The Pale, Immortal Ruler
Episodes.Description: Continuing the investigation of Achromatic Darkness, Clover reaches a floor of the dungeon that has... a sky?

Episodes.Title: One Who Was Once a Friend
Episodes.Description: Yuke decides to head back into Achromatic Darkness to save Jamie, but Simon stands in the way.

Episodes.Title: A Six-Leaf Clover
Episodes.Description: Shortly after Nene and Jamie officially join Clover, the party learns about a newly discovered dungeon.

Episodes.Title: Clover's Back in Action!
Episodes.Description: Clover travels to a newly discovered dungeon to undertake their first quest since returning to adventuring.

Episodes.Title: The Capital Distorted by the Twilight
Episodes.Description: Clover takes their first dive into the new dungeon near Duna, and everything they encounter feels off somehow.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Priestess
Episodes.Description: As scholars assess Clover's findings from the new dungeon, the unconscious girl they found inside wakes up.

Episodes.Title: Biblion, the Book Spirit
Episodes.Description: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im with three other parties in hopes of uncovering the truth of the twilight city.

Episodes.Title: One Gold
Episodes.Description: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im to infiltrate Vordan Castle and destroy the One Gold that threatens the world.

Episodes.Title: Crossing Time
Episodes.Description: Clover must battle the monsters of Glad Shi-im and even their own allies to find and destroy the One Gold.

Episodes.Title: Return From the Twilight, And...
Episodes.Description: When Yuke returns from Glad Shi-im, he learns that Rain has gone to see Mastoma, the Salmutarian prince.

Episodes.Title: The Seven-Leaf Clover
Episodes.Description: Clover returns to Finis with Niberune, who has officially become their seventh party member.

Episodes.Title: King's Order
Episodes.Description: A long-sealed dungeon in Salmutaria is reawakening, and King Vincent wants Yuke to go there and check it out.

Episodes.Title: The Dungeon Count of Welmelia
Episodes.Description: Clover begins their adventure in Salmutaria by inspecting the path to the dungeon that has reawakened there.

Episodes.Title: The World Turns Inside-Out
Episodes.Description: Clover's inspection of the dungeon in Salmutaria suddenly takes a frightening turn.

Episodes.Title: Tenebre
Episodes.Description: Prince Rafuma's reckless assault on Tenebre yields further insight into its truly terrifying nature.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Reunion
Episodes.Description: Clover finally enters Tenebre, fully expecting the unexpected... and still, what they find inside shocks them.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Clover heads into the depths of Achromatic Darkness to find its Abyss Gate.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Dream
Episodes.Description: Clover reaches the Abyss Gate in the depths of Achromatic Darkness, but can they succeed in closing it?

Entries.Title: Women Wearing Shoulder Pads
Entries.Description: A mysterious stalker follows Marioneta as she launches a new business venture. Is the stalker a lover, an enemy, or a little mix of both?

Episodes.Title: Ámame Ódiame
Episodes.Description: A mysterious stalker follows Marioneta as she launches a new business venture. Is the stalker a lover, an enemy, or a little mix of both?

Episodes.Title: ¿Quieres? ¿Quieres? ¡Compra!
Episodes.Description: Marioneta confronts her greatest business rival, Doña Quispe, but she doesn't come empty-handed. She brings a duck.

Episodes.Title: Corazón Retorcido
Episodes.Description: Marioneta attends a meeting of animal rights activists in order to befriend a twelve-year-old girl named Nina Quispe.

Episodes.Title: El Cordón Umbilical
Episodes.Description: Marioneta wakes up in a warehouse, terrified and traumatized. She must overcome her fears to direct a TV commercial.

Episodes.Title: La Misma Noche Que Anoche
Episodes.Description: Marioneta throws a New Year's Eve party that ends with her in flames.

Episodes.Title: Tres Tristes Tigres
Episodes.Description: Coquita, Espada and Nina go on a road trip to discover the truth behind Marioneta's cuys.

Episodes.Title: Madre Pródiga
Episodes.Description: All secrets are revealed as the sun sets over Nina and Coquita sitting on the edge of a cliff.

Episodes.Title: Mami Mami Mami
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
Entries.Description: Kaji, the ace of the sales department, has a secret—he's gay. But dating apps have been a bust, and finding his ideal match seems impossible. Then, one day, he's sent on an overnight business trip with Fukami, a quiet, unassuming guy from the engineering team. At first, Kaji isn't impressed. But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Episodes.Title: A guy to suit Mr.Perfect
Episodes.Description: Kaji, the ace of the sales department, has a secret—he's gay. But dating apps have been a bust, and finding his ideal match seems impossible. Then, one day, he's sent on an overnight business trip with Fukami, a quiet, unassuming guy from the engineering team. At first, Kaji isn't impressed. But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Episodes.Title: What's Your Game, Zero?!
Episodes.Description: After returning from the business trip, Fukami keeps ignoring Kaji. No one on the dating apps looks a good as Fukami, though! Then, one evening, the two wind up alone together at the office. Fukami tries to leave as if nothing happened, leaving Kaji to say some pretty unexpected things to secure a second date.

Episodes.Title: Fukami and... a Girl?!
Episodes.Description: Kaji consoles a coworker who discovers he'd been dating a married man, and then happens to spot Fukami out with a lady as well, shopping for a ring! The stunned Kaji decides to ask the people at IT if Fukami has a fiancee, only to learn Fukami has been out for the last three days. A concerned Kaji heads to Fukami's house...

Episodes.Title: Say My Name
Episodes.Description: Kaji gets back the smartphone he left at Fukami's place—with Fukami's contact details snuck inside the case! Wanting to see if his feelings are the real deal, Kaji sets a date with Fukami for drinks. On the day of, however, Kaji is caught up by how cute Fukumi is, and things take them back to Kaji's place...

Episodes.Title: I Won't Go Easy On You!
Episodes.Description: Kaji is shocked to see Fukami's new haicut. But Kaji isn't the only one in the office to notice what Fukami has to offer. In a mere three days, he'd gone from a zero to a total ladies' man. Kaji is both annoyed and compelled by Fukami's obliviousness at his own appeal. Seizing the initiative, he ties up Fukami with his necktie...!

Episodes.Title: Sorry, I've Got a Cold
Episodes.Description: After walking home in the pouring rain after being pushed away by Fukami, Kaji has caught a cold. He falls asleep regretting how he told Fukami "We should stop seeing each other for a while." Awakening to the sound of someone calling his name, he sees a worried Fukami peering back at him. Caught up in the shock, Kaji graps Fukamiu close for a kiss...

Episodes.Title: I Couldn't Help But Be Attracted
Episodes.Description: Kaji thought he didn't need love in his life, but meeting Fukami changed that, and so he refuses to just give in. After a simple honest mistake, Kaji's coworker tells him he's just fine without being perfect. Kaji wonders how those words might strike Fukami, and begins to reminisce about their times together...

Episodes.Title: Is It So Bad if I Fall in Love?
Episodes.Description: Kaji goes to see Fukami at the hospital only to be asked what relation he has to the patient. Tears begin to come as he searches for an answer. Realizing how important Fukami truly is to him, the man himself appears right behind him! The two proceed to clear up their miscommunication, and make progress toward to putting aside ill will...

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Hotel
Entries.Description: Yachiyo and her staff are ready to welcome you to the Gingarou Hotel... except there's nobody left on Earth.

Episodes.Title: A True Hotel Is Always Storied
Episodes.Description: Yachiyo and her staff are ready to welcome you to the Gingarou Hotel... except there's nobody left on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Tradition Evolves with Innovation and Experimentation
Episodes.Description: The Gingarou Hotel gets its first guest in over a century, but he's not human! Do aliens even count as guests?

Episodes.Title: A Smile Is the Ultimate Ambiance
Episodes.Description: A group of humans return to Earth... but not all is as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Food and Etiquette Are Mainstays of Culture
Episodes.Description: Yachiyo and Ponko head out in search of new ingredients.

Episodes.Title: Provide Unlimited Hospitality in Limited Time
Episodes.Description: A new pair of aliens arrive at the hotel, but the shortage of alcohol will be a problem.

Episodes.Title: Our Only Vice Is Service
Episodes.Description: The end times have come to Earth... and it seems they will be staying at the Gingarou Hotel?

Episodes.Title: Bow Down Deep But Always Aim High
Episodes.Description: The gang decides to launch a satellite for promotion, but Ponko has other ideas.

Episodes.Title: Discipline with a Fist! Reconcile with a High Five!
Episodes.Description: What happens after Yachiyo gets stranded in space?

Episodes.Title: Bookmark Today's Page in Our Guests' Lives
Episodes.Description: After reconciling with Yachiyo, Ponko has some news to share.

Episodes.Title: Clean Sheets Symbolize Pure Hearts
Episodes.Description: The Gingarou receives an unnerving guest who requests total secrecy about his visit...

Episodes.Title: Wag Your Tail, but Never Wag a Shift!
Episodes.Description: Labor standards say Yachiyo has been overworked, and Ponko demands that she take time off.

Episodes.Title: Aim to Be the Number One Hotel in the Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Gingarou and Earth receive a visit from an old, old friend.

Entries.Title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
Entries.Description: Alina became a guild receptionist because she thought it'd be an easy, safe, secure job. However, in reality, she's so swamped with work that she's stuck pulling overtime day after day... and she's had enough!

Episodes.Title: I'm a Guild Receptionist, so I Want a Peaceful Life
Episodes.Description: Alina became a guild receptionist because she thought it'd be an easy, safe, secure job. However, in reality, she's so swamped with work that she's stuck pulling overtime day after day... and she's had enough!

Episodes.Title: I May Be the Executioner, but I'll Be Fired if People Find Out, so I'll Have to Use Force
Episodes.Description: Jade has found out that Alina is the Executioner and hounds her to join Silver Sword. Then a certain adventurer with a grudge sets a raid boss loose...

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Tank, but I Want to Take On a Really Tough Dungeon
Episodes.Description: Glen has learned Alina's secret and proposes a duel. If she loses, she must go to the Chalk Tower with Silver Sword.

Episodes.Title: Relics, Secret Quests, and Dark Gods Keep Interfering with My Work, so I'll Destroy Them All
Episodes.Description: The guiding crystal Jade gave Alina starts to glow, signaling that he's in peril, so Alina rushes to help.

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Healer, but Even I Could Use Some Healing
Episodes.Description: Even after nursing Jade and Lowe back to health, Lululee is depressed over the loss of her weapon and skills.

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Back Attacker, but I'm Gonna Catch the Jerk Who Started That Rumor
Episodes.Description: Alina and Silver Sword go undercover to find the source of the rumor about relics that grant Dia skills.

Episodes.Title: I've Waited Forever for the Centennial Festival, so I'm Gonna Enjoy It, No Matter What
Episodes.Description: While Alina finally enjoys her first Centennial Festival, Lululee confronts the shadows of her past.

Episodes.Title: I May Be a Useless Healer, but I'm Going to Do Everything I Can
Episodes.Description: As Alina and Jade struggle in battle against a dark god, Lululee questions her role as a healer.

Episodes.Title: I May Be in My Third Year as a Guild Receptionist, but I'm Starting New-Employee Training
Episodes.Description: Alina attends new-employee training in hopes of learning how she can avoid working overtime ever again.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost May Show Up During Training, but Nobody Told Me About It
Episodes.Description: Jade suspects that the "man in black" who's been luring adventurers into danger is someone he knows very well.

Episodes.Title: It May Be a Trap, but I Have to Keep Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Deep beneath guild HQ, Alina and Silver Sword find the "man in black," who finally reveals his identity.

Episodes.Title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, But I'll Fight to the Bitter End to Get Out of Working Overtime
Episodes.Description: Glen attacks Alina and Silver Sword ruthlessly, but they still cling to the hope of saving him.

Entries.Title: My Melody & Kuromi
Entries.Description: Tired of being overshadowed, Kuromi steals precious ingredients from her rival. My Melody ventures into the forest and stumbles upon a strange discovery.

Episodes.Title: What's This? My Heart Is Pounding
Episodes.Description: Tired of being overshadowed, Kuromi steals precious ingredients from her rival. My Melody ventures into the forest and stumbles upon a strange discovery.

Episodes.Title: Fluffy and Soft
Episodes.Description: Up in the clouds, My Melody has an ominous encounter with a giant, fluffy bear. Back in Mariland, Flat encourages her to join the upcoming sweets contest.

Episodes.Title: Kuromi's Great Recipe Heist
Episodes.Description: My Melody's new creation is delightfully light and airy with a satisfying crunch. Unhappy with her own recipes, Kuromi sneaks into her rival's home.

Episodes.Title: Honey Car Chase!
Episodes.Description: Everyone loves My Melody's new cupcakes, but mean online reviews upset her. Determined to uncover her baking secrets, Tanba and Sasage chase her down.

Episodes.Title: The Sweets Contest Begins
Episodes.Description: Ready, set... bake! My Melody, Flat and Piano impress the crowd with their teamwork. Can Kuromi steal the spotlight with her wild creation?

Episodes.Title: The Secret of Kuromi's Dorayaki
Episodes.Description: Kuromi's wildest dreams have come true! She's now the most popular patissier in Mariland. But Mr. Pistachio's help might be a recipe for trouble...

Episodes.Title: What Should I Do?
Episodes.Description: Chased into the forest by ravenous villagers, My Melody and Kuromi find themselves in a jam — until a thunderous voice comes to their rescue.

Episodes.Title: Time for Teamwork
Episodes.Description: As My Melody faces her home and town in ruins, Tanba and Sasage get punished for coming clean about their past. Kuromi turns to her friend for help.

Episodes.Title: To the Cloud Kingdom!
Episodes.Description: Amidst the rubble, My Melody shares her honest feelings with Kuromi. They decide to return to the Cloud Kingdom together to set things right.

Episodes.Title: Pistachio's Past
Episodes.Description: While Flat and Piano continue researching the Cloud Kingdom's history and the tragedy that befell it, My Melody and Kuromi confront Pistachio.

Episodes.Title: All for Our Best Friend
Episodes.Description: Kuromi desperately tries to awaken My Melody while Pistachio moves forward with his plan. But things turn sour as an uncontrollable rot spreads.

Episodes.Title: My Melody & Kuromi
Episodes.Description: For three days, My Melody's friends struggle to stay awake, watching over her as she dreams of her Mama's words of wisdom. Will Mariland be saved in time?

Entries.Title: The Beginning After the End
Entries.Description: Having defeated countless enemies, obtaining wealth, fame, and everything else imaginable, the most powerful king, Grey, abruptly dies one day. He then awakens suddenly, having reincarnated in a world where magic exists. He is given the name Arthur, and begins living a second life, with loving parents.

Episodes.Title: The Rebirth of the King
Episodes.Description: Having defeated countless enemies, obtaining wealth, fame, and everything else imaginable, the most powerful king, Grey, abruptly dies one day. He then awakens suddenly, having reincarnated in a world where magic exists. He is given the name Arthur, and begins living a second life, with loving parents.

Episodes.Title: The King, Under Attack
Episodes.Description: The Leywin family travels to the floating city of Xyrus so that Arthur can begin his formal education in magic. The adventuring party that Reynolds and Alice belong to, the Twin Horns, accompany them as guards, when they run into something unexpected...

Episodes.Title: Meeting the King
Episodes.Description: During the battle with the bandits, Arthur falls off of a cliff. When he awakens he encounters a mysterious beast, clad in armor. Her name is Sylvia. She helps Arthur, and seems to know where his family is, but who is she really...?

Episodes.Title: Saved by the King
Episodes.Description: Having parted ways with Sylvia, Arthur hears a girl's scream in the woods. Upon rushing to the voice, he encounters an elf girl named Tessia, who has been captured by slavers. With Sylvia's words to "seek light in his new life" ringing in his ears, Arthur decides to challenge them by himself.

Episodes.Title: The King's Test
Episodes.Description: Arthur arrives in the Elenoir Kingdom with Tessia, before being arrested by elvish soldiers who harbor deep resentment toward humans. Things are looking tense until Elenoir's former ruler, Virion, has him released. Arthur is then invited to the kingdom's castle. But the pain in his mana core seems to be getting worse...

Episodes.Title: The King's Training
Episodes.Description: After being informed of a way to let Reynolds and Alice know about his survival, Arthur joins Virion and they head to a witch's house. Using special sorcery, he is able to see his parents. Witnessing the depth of their grief, Arthur decides that he will train under Virion to protect those he cares about, and to control the dangerous power growing within him.

Episodes.Title: The King Says Goodbye
Episodes.Description: It's been three years after Arthur began his training in the Kingdom of Elenoir, having worked alongside Tessia as they both grew stronger. Arthur enlists Virion's help in order to awaken the beast that slumbers within his mana core. Then, one night, the stone Sylvia gave him begins to shine…

Episodes.Title: Reunited with the King
Episodes.Description: Having arrived in the city of Xyrus, Arthur is thrilled to meet his younger sister, Eleanor, and to reunite with his parents. While sparring with Reynolds, he demonstrates how much he has grown. After witnessing Arthur's strength, Vincent Helstea proposes that the reborn king enroll in Xyrus Academy, a prestigious sorcery school.

Episodes.Title: The King Teaches
Episodes.Description: Vincent and his wife Tabitha are hoping to enroll their daughter, Lilia, in Xyrus Academy. And while Lilia hopes to live up to her parents’ expectations, she has yet to awaken her mana. In the meantime, Arthur runs into a group of the academy’s students while shopping in town.

Episodes.Title: The King’s Defiance
Episodes.Description: The Helstea Auction, which even the royals of the Sapin Kingdom attend, is opened. Vincent invites Arthur to the auction house. While among valuables on offer, Arthur discovers Sylvie has gone missing, and that she’s attracted the attention of a court sorcerer in the service of the Sapin Royal family!

Episodes.Title: The King’s Decision
Episodes.Description: Having arrived at Xyrus Academy, Arthur displays his skills to the school’s director, Cynthia, who proves to be every bit as formidable as her position as the head of the prestigious magic academy suggests. Despite being overwhelmed, Arthur still shows his power and the two strike a deal...

Episodes.Title: The King’s Departure
Episodes.Description: Donning a mask and taking up the alter-ego of Note, Arthur arrives at the guild to begin service as an adventurer. He has new encounters meeting Elijah, a young boy with ties to dwarven royalty, and Lucas, a half-elf member of the Sapin royal family. Afterwards, Arthur and Jasmine leave on their first adventure together. In order to protect those he cares for, the king seeks even greater power.

Entries.Title: Your Forma
Entries.Description: The main suspect in a recent assault case turns out to be Harold. However, during Harold's interrogation, someone else attacks his flatmate, Darya. Echika "Brain Dives" into Darya's "Your Forma" where she sees the attacker's face—which is identical to Harold's.

Episodes.Title: Mechanical Friends Amicus Robots
Episodes.Description: The main suspect in a recent assault case turns out to be Harold. However, during Harold's interrogation, someone else attacks his flatmate, Darya. Echika "Brain Dives" into Darya's "Your Forma" where she sees the attacker's face—which is identical to Harold's.

Episodes.Title: A Black Box
Episodes.Description: While interviewing Lexie, Echika receives a report about the ongoing investigation. It only strengthens her suspicions towards Harold. Echika decides to get to the bottom of this case, but shortly after, something unexpected happens to her.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: It seemed like the investigation had advanced after apprehending Furman, but instead the case ends up taking a new turn. After further deductions, Echika and Harold arrive at a place where…

Episodes.Title: Regret
Episodes.Description: Echika, having realized Furman's true motives, discovers the shocking truth…and it's a huge secret involving Harold.

Episodes.Title: Persona
Episodes.Description: Echika feels uneasy from keeping the major secret about Harold. In the meantime, posts targeting the Cybercrime Investigation Department have been exposed on a message board.

Episodes.Title: Father and Daughter
Episodes.Description: Echika and her team found the spot where E's followers meet up. Bigga, who's helping with the investigation, can't contain her shock when she sees a certain person there.

Episodes.Title: Flower of Fire
Episodes.Description: The forces of evil hadn't stopped with the explosion at Totoki's apartment, they've also been creeping up on Echika. Once again, she finds herself in danger, and Harold takes on the taboo…

Episodes.Title: Fiction
Episodes.Description: Cyber-Inspector Echika and Assistant-inspector Harold once again partner up. Thanks to Harold's strategy, the real villain has finally come to light, but behind the culprit lies an unexpected truth.

Episodes.Title: The Nightmare of Petersburg
Episodes.Description: The time has come to reveal Harold's past. Once a wandering, lost Amicus, Harold was taken in by Sozon and began working alongside him as a detective. But then a gruesome case that would later be known as "The Nightmare of Petersburg” shook their world...

Episodes.Title: Footsteps of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: After receiving an incomprehensible report from Totoki, Echika, and Harold head to the municipal police to find out the truth. It turns out that the report was about a phone call from someone who was never supposed to be able to reach them…

Episodes.Title: Replay of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Echika and Harold grow more and more suspicious upon learning that Abaev was the one who received the digital clone requested by Elena. At the same time, another incident once again mimicking the "Nightmare" takes place. The victim this time turns out to be someone completely unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Manifestation of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Harold and Bigga notice what all the victims from these attacks have in common from the message Echika left behind. They identify who and where the culprit is, and rush to rescue the abducted Echika, but…

Episodes.Title: Dawn of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: It's time for Harold and Echika to confront each other. Echika tries to reason with Harold, who's burning with the desire for revenge. In the end, Harold comes to a decision, and―

Entries.Title: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess
Entries.Description: Rua, who is called the defective saint, risks her life to save her beloved Garrot. However, her achievement is stolen by her best friend Arian, and the two become engaged. Having lost everything, Rua vows to take revenge on those who believed in her.

Episodes.Title: Scarred Saint
Episodes.Description: Rua, who is called the defective saint, risks her life to save her beloved Garrot. However, her achievement is stolen by her best friend Arian, and the two become engaged. Having lost everything, Rua vows to take revenge on those who believed in her.

Episodes.Title: Darkness of the Temple
Episodes.Description: After being betrayed by Arian, the second prince, Sven, appears before Rua. Sven proposes revenge, and Rua learns of the shocking dark secrets of the temple.

Episodes.Title: Suspicious Figure
Episodes.Description: In search of the cause of the magical beasts' attacks, Rua sneaks out of the room at night and finds suspicious figures.

Entries.Title: Tasokare Hotel
Entries.Description: Neko Tsukahara wakes up in a vast, desolate wilderness, where the twilight stretches to the horizon. She has no memory of who is or how she ended up there. Suddenly, the "Tasogare Hotel" appears behind her. Upon entering, she is greeted by a manager with a head on fire. Unsure whether she's alive or dead, Neko begins searching for a way to regain her memories, when a mysterious guest arrives.

Episodes.Title: Twilight Girl
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara wakes up in a vast, desolate wilderness, where the twilight stretches to the horizon. She has no memory of who is or how she ended up there. Suddenly, the "Tasogare Hotel" appears behind her. Upon entering, she is greeted by a manager with a head on fire. Unsure whether she's alive or dead, Neko begins searching for a way to regain her memories, when a mysterious guest arrives.

Episodes.Title: The Bet of a Lifetime
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara decides to work at the "Tasogare Hotel", a place that exists between the worlds of the living and the dead. Under the guidance of Atori-senpai, she begins her strange life there. One day, a guest with a love for gambling and a pachinko ball for a head requests a game of mahjong. Later, as she tries to tidy up his cluttered room, an old black telephone suddenly starts ringing...

Episodes.Title: The Blood-Soaked Pansy
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara is settling into her job at Tasogare Hotel. Hoping to prove herself, she volunteers to assist a new guest—a man with a pansy-shaped head and an unsettling vibe. After escorting him to his room, Neko searches for clues to help him recover his memories. She soon discovers that in the living world, he was a medical student and part-time detective named Masaki Osoto.

Episodes.Title: Friendship and Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara and Haruto Atori guide two unusual guests—one with a kendo mask for a head and the other with a smartphone head—at the Tasogare Hotel. Clues in their rooms reveal the women were childhood friends and members of the same high school kendo club. As their rooms transform, they gradually recover memories of their shared past and the events that brought them to the Tasogare Hotel.

Episodes.Title: The Seaside Ash-covered Princess
Episodes.Description: Neko and Ruri escort a loving couple to an ocean-view suite, where the woman has a sudden realization. While searching, they find a Cinderella script, sparking memories of the couple's past, though their fate remains unknown. As Osoto and Neko discuss the relationship's oddities, a piercing scream from the woman echoes through the hotel.

Episodes.Title: Space and Music
Episodes.Description: A rocket-headed boy and a black cat wander into Tasokare Hotel. The boy chases the cat around, desperate to befriend it, but never catches it. The cat keeps its distance yet stays close, silently watching over him. Just then, a record-headed guest appears and cheers up the boy. As they play, the boy realizes this man is the legendary saxophonist who once inspired Atori to pursue music.

Episodes.Title: A Carousel and Brass Knuckles
Episodes.Description: Neko runs into Ruri as she is about to leave her room. Looking inside the room, Neko learns what happened to Ruri in the living world. Then a woman with a brass knuckle head arrives at the hotel. She seems disinterested in searching her room for clues, but eventually Neko learns that the woman is a single mother. And Ruri starts to notice similarities between her own mother and the new guest…

Episodes.Title: The Idol Girl
Episodes.Description: National idol group 365 Sister Q (aka 3Q)’s Kaneko Konomi arrives at the hotel. Neko is thrilled to meet her longtime idol. Unlike other guests, Kaneko’s face remains unaltered, and she still has her name and memories. During a meal, a radio in the restaurant suddenly airs 3Q’s press conference - revealing Kaneko’s fate. She entrusts Neko with her final, unfulfilled wish.

Episodes.Title: A Girl's True Face
Episodes.Description: With Konomi Kaneko’s long-lost solo performance - her final wish - approaching, Neko scrambles to gather band members. She repeatedly tries to convince Atori to join as the saxophonist, but he refuses due to a painful past. Can they pull off the concert and send Kaneko off to the afterlife as she wished? As emotions clash, the stage is set for a night of fate and farewells.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Room
Episodes.Description: After successfully pulling off Konomi Kaneko’s live show and making peace with Atori, Neko suddenly recalls a past-life incident, though the details remain unclear. Meanwhile, Atori mentions Osoto's complaints about room service. Curious and unconvinced, Neko heads to the room alone, notices something has changed, and as she digs deeper, she uncovers a hidden room…

Episodes.Title: Handguns and Hell
Episodes.Description: Neko discovers a hidden room belonging to Osoto, where she finds a diary listing new victims and countless photos of Atori from the living world. Convinced he’s scheming something at the hotel, she prepares to stop him. Kiriko tells her about a special handgun in the manager’s office and determined, she confronts Osoto, demanding to know why he’s obsessed with Atori even now.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: In the heat of battle, Osoto is shot and killed. As a consequence, Atori is dragged into the depths of Hell. Given a chance to turn back time, Neko returns, determined to face Osoto one last time.

Episodes.Title: Something Bad / Another Mountain / I'll Tempt You!

Entries.Title: Ameku M.D.: Doctor Detective
Entries.Description: Ameku Takao is a genius doctor with a knack for solving all kinds of difficult cases. When a man with blue blood is brought to Tenikai General Hospital—where Takao is the vice-director—after having his leg bitten off by a large beast, she starts investigating the intriguing case with the aid of her colleague, Takanashi.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Sherlock
Episodes.Description: Ameku Takao is a genius doctor with a knack for solving all kinds of difficult cases. When a man with blue blood is brought to Tenikai General Hospital—where Takao is the vice-director—after having his leg bitten off by a large beast, she starts investigating the intriguing case with the aid of her colleague, Takanashi.

Episodes.Title: Blue Blood Cells and Dragon Fangs
Episodes.Description: Takao comes to the conclusion that the "large beast" responsible for severing the man's leg was, in fact, a Tyrannosaurus Rex. Following this shocking deduction, the case rapidly develops, and she and her crew head to the place where they hope to get answers to the remaining mystery of the victim's blue blood.

Episodes.Title: Into the Spell of Shimmering Light
Episodes.Description: "Do you believe a video can be cursed?" A girl walks in front of a train after watching a particular video and is subsequently admitted to a psych ward. Takao is the only one who believes her twin sister when she says it wasn't a suicide attempt but the result of watching a cursed video, and the genius doctor sets about investigating.

Episodes.Title: Spontaneous Human Combustion
Episodes.Description: "All who desecrate my grave shall be cursed to die." A university research team examining a grave reportedly linked to renowned onmyoji, Ashiya Doman, have started complaining about not feeling well, one after another. Takao is asked to investigate, but the case takes an unexpected turn.

Episodes.Title: Crimson Curse of the Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: Takao's diagnosis seems to solve Enzo's Curse. However, due to a mysterious death by fire, the investigation is right back at square one.

Episodes.Title: Fierce Blazing Finale
Episodes.Description: Despite another occurrence of the mysterious spontaneous human combustion phenomenon, the suspect arrested denies any involvement in either case.

Episodes.Title: Prescribed Poison
Episodes.Description: Takao gets sued for malpractice! The hospital director uses the lawsuit to push for the disbandment of the Department of Investigative Pathology.

Episodes.Title: The Night When the Angels Danced (1)
Episodes.Description: Several hospital staff report an angel in one room, and a pediatrician asks Takao for help with three children.

Episodes.Title: The Night When the Angels Danced (2)
Episodes.Description: Takao reveals the true identity of the "angel."

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (1)
Episodes.Description: Dr. Takanashi is ordered to return to the university hospital.

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (2)
Episodes.Description: Takao tries to clear Seiji's name before he is arrested by the police.

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (3)
Episodes.Description: The mystery of the drowned man is revealed.

Entries.Title: I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons
Entries.Description: Leticia loved playing in nature before she was sent to the castle as a candidate to marry Prince Clarke. Years of harsh princess lessons seem to have transformed Leticia into a lady... until a ball one night where she finds her prince with another woman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Leticia loved playing in nature before she was sent to the castle as a candidate to marry Prince Clarke. Years of harsh princess lessons seem to have transformed Leticia into a lady... until a ball one night where she finds her prince with another woman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Leticia moves to her family's countryside estate and spends her time frolicking in nature. While she is fishing one day, her ex-fiancé Clarke suddenly appears. Puzzled by the visit, Leticia shows Clarke around the village and then learns a shocking fact.

Episodes.Title: I Wish you Happiness
Episodes.Description: Clarke forces Leticia to return to the castle. Upon arriving, he promises that she will be able to spend as much time in nature as she wants. Leticia starts to wonder if marriage is not such an awful idea after all, but she still yearns for more freedom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Stuck behind bars in a new room, Leticia talks to Brianna and Nadir about her hopes and dreams before noticing a hidden door during an escape attempt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: When Leticia steps out from an evening ball after seeing Clarke with another woman, she is suddenly kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With the help of her friends, Leticia temporarily leaves the castle to investigate Clarke's new mystery lover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Louis plots to woo Maria with a surprise gift of macarons but instead triggers a tense, late-night ghost hunt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Clarke thinks back on Leticia's early days at the castle and reevaluates his naive attempts to make her happy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Shortly after Leticia resumes her lessons, a strange incident occurs at the newly renovated conservatory bath.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Leticia recalls joyful childhood memories after Queen Laura reminds her that Prince Clarke was her first love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: With wedding preparations in full swing, rumors spread that Clarke wishes to renounce his claim to the throne.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Leticia and Clarke settle in to married life as their friends playfully encourage them to take the next step.

Entries.Title: Devil May Cry
Entries.Description: A violent heist at a Vatican City museum sparks chaos, pulling unsuspecting demon hunter Dante into a sinister plot to forge a rift between worlds.

Episodes.Title: Inferno
Episodes.Description: A violent heist at a Vatican City museum sparks chaos, pulling unsuspecting demon hunter Dante into a sinister plot to forge a rift between worlds.

Episodes.Title: Our Lady of Sorrows
Episodes.Description: In Washington, DARKCOM gathers a group of mercenaries and offers a bounty to bring in Dante — and the family heirloom that hangs around his neck.

Episodes.Title: The Deep and Savage Way
Episodes.Description: A flashback sheds light on Mary's past. In the present, a convoy with precious cargo hits a roadblock as the White Rabbit creeps closer to his prey.

Episodes.Title: All Hope Abandon
Episodes.Description: The amulet's signal leads DARKCOM to a run-down apartment building. But is it really the Rabbit's lair... or a trap? Dante learns his true origins.

Episodes.Title: Descent
Episodes.Description: Grim discoveries complicate Mary's mission. An exhilarating free fall fuels an epic transformation, forcing Dante to confront his demon side.

Episodes.Title: The First Circle
Episodes.Description: A revealing trip down the rabbit hole yields a haunting tale of two childhoods — parallel stories with intertwining fates.

Episodes.Title: At the Gates of Paradise
Episodes.Description: The stage is set for the ultimate showdown as the Rabbit and his army lie in wait for Dante to arrive. But there's more than one hero ready to fight.

Episodes.Title: A River of Blood and Fire
Episodes.Description: Dante and Mary face impossible choices — and an enemy more powerful than the world has ever seen. In the aftermath, Baines puts a bold plan into motion.

Episodes.Description: Satoko attempts to buy new clothes for herself and runs into Kuro, the leader of the runaway ninjas.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Job
Episodes.Description: Satoko tries to find a part-time job, but it's not as easy as she thought, and Kuro's SO appears!

Episodes.Description: Satoko attempts to charm Konoha with Kuro's suggestions.

Episodes.Description: Satoko is replaced by... A robot? And Konoha is none the wiser, forming an unshakable bond with the robot.

Episodes.Description: With the help of Marin's invention, Satoko tries a new ninja skill: Breast Storage Ninjutsu!

Episodes.Title: An Assassin and Her Classmate's Friend
Episodes.Description: Satoko takes interest in social media while Konoha is introduced to school prodigy, Aoi, who helps with her future career plans.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Big House
Episodes.Description: Satoko and Konoha move out, but it appears they're not alone in their big new house.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Experiment
Episodes.Description: Satoko needs to find a new iconic outfit and find out the extent of her ninjutsu's capabilities.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and a Baby Assassin
Episodes.Description: Marin is kidnapped and Konoha is turned into a baby! It's up to Satoko to save the day.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Big Dilemma
Episodes.Description: Satoko's injured and Konoha takes on challenging missions due to her career and life being on the line.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: As Satoko waits to hear back from Konoha, she gets a few upgrades. But will Konoha come home safe and sound?

Entries.Description: A Japanese man who likes cooking and sewing is reborn as a chubby noble child.

Episodes.Title: I Got My Memories From My Past Life Back!
Episodes.Description: A Japanese man who likes cooking and sewing is reborn as a chubby noble child.

Episodes.Title: My First Time Meeting My Brother
Episodes.Description: Ageha meets his young brother Regulus for the first time, and learns about his family.

Episodes.Title: The Kikunoi Family's Circumstances
Episodes.Description: Ageha is forced to confront his family's ugliness.

Episodes.Title: I Made Origami for My Brother, and Chawan-Mushi for Me
Episodes.Description: Ageha makes him and his brother special things that remind him of his old home.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Think I'm Going to Live a Long Life
Episodes.Description: Ageha tries to think of ways he can help foster Regulus's education.

Episodes.Title: My Embroidery Sold
Episodes.Description: Ageha takes a trip into town for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Using Magic to Visit the Capital
Episodes.Description: Ageha takes a trip to the capital and meets two musicians.

Episodes.Title: H-Hello! It's an Honor to Meet You!
Episodes.Description: Ageha meets another god, one who has a lot to say to him.

Episodes.Title: The Greatest Singer in the Empire Is Born!
Episodes.Description: Ageha goes to see Maria's performance in the capital.

Episodes.Title: My Heart Is Full of Teachings and Sincerity
Episodes.Description: Ageha's family is concerned about his well-being and would like him to enjoy his childhood more.

Episodes.Title: I Made a Friend
Episodes.Description: Ageha makes his first friend in his new life.

Episodes.Title: I'll Use My Memories from a Past Life to Make a Business Deal
Episodes.Description: Ageha comes up with a big plan to bring prosperity to the Kikunoi lands.

Entries.Title: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
Entries.Description: Kenzaburo Tondabayashi is a staunch, 52-year-old bureaucrat until he seemingly dies in a traffic accident! He then finds himself reincarnated into the world of the Otome game.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Villainess
Episodes.Description: Kenzaburo Tondabayashi is a staunch, 52-year-old bureaucrat until he seemingly dies in a traffic accident! He then finds himself reincarnated into the world of the Otome game.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: It is only proper that Kenzaburo commits himself to Grace’s villainous role in the original story. Unfortunately, decades of learned habits are difficult to break.

Episodes.Title: Dad Makes a Pun!
Episodes.Description: Grace, aka Kenzaburo, integrates himself into the student council. He may be an effective bureaucrat, but his resourcefulness and modesty are raising unnecessary love flags.

Episodes.Title: Dad Summons a Beast
Episodes.Description: The day the students' familiars hatch arrives at long last. Meanwhile, in another world, two women must come to terms with the fate of a beloved husband and father.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets Into Dual-wielding
Episodes.Description: Impressed by a rare accomplishment, the principal asks Grace aka Kenzaburo to participate in the Magic Exhibition.

Episodes.Title: Dad is Moved to Tears
Episodes.Description: Grace and Anna have both proven their worth time and time again. Unfortunately, there are those who insist on sowing division between them.

Episodes.Title: Dad Puts On an Exhibition
Episodes.Description: Grace’s father returns after a business trip, but proves he doesn’t know his daughter very well. However, as a fellow father, Kenzaburo understands that the man is trying.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Maid
Episodes.Description: Grace aka Kenzaburo invites Anna to stay at the Auvergne estate over the summer when it becomes clear she still needs to learn the ins and outs of high society.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets Trapped
Episodes.Description: When the student council gets trapped in a labyrinth, it's up to Grace aka Kenzaburo and Anna to save everyone.

Episodes.Title: Dad Cross-Dresses
Episodes.Description: Grace aka Kenzaburo goes incognito to visit the bakery that Anna's family runs, but Anna's mother quickly deduces Grace's identity.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets into an Elegant Pickle!
Episodes.Description: The student council decides to put on a gender-swapping play with Anna in the lead role! Unfortunately, Anna overworks herself to the point of collapse.

Episodes.Title: Dad Celebrates at the Campus Festival
Episodes.Description: The Elegance Cheat has a fatal flaw: Grace aka Kenzaburo can't perform without everything becoming unnecessarily fancy!

Entries.Description: While getting drenched in the rain, Fuji encounters an "abandoned dog" on the street and brings it home.

Episodes.Description: While getting drenched in the rain, Fuji encounters an "abandoned dog" on the street and brings it home.

Episodes.Title: The Evening Sun
Episodes.Description: Fuji and her "dog" go on a walk with her neighbor Kii and her dog Kinako. Then Fuji's dad, Tatsuo, shows up.

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: Fuji's friends from school, Ren and Mimi, visit her for a gyoza party.

Episodes.Title: Summer Festival
Episodes.Description: You, Fuji, Kii, and Fuji's parents go to the summer festival, and You disappears.

Episodes.Title: The Same Moon
Episodes.Description: Fuji meets manga artist Tokaku Arata in a video meeting. You and Fuji meet Medaka and Noriko on their walk.

Episodes.Title: The Cat and Pumpkins
Episodes.Description: Fuji's twin brother, Teru, and his pregnant wife, Wako, leave their cat at Fuji's.

Episodes.Title: It's Nothing
Episodes.Description: Fuji encounters a writer's block and cannot get out of it.

Episodes.Title: The Cry
Episodes.Description: Fuji hears You cry for the first time.

Episodes.Title: A Secret
Episodes.Description: It turns out that Fuji doesn't want others to know she's a writer.

Entries.Title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+

Episodes.Title: Mickey's New Helper
Episodes.Description: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!

Episodes.Title: Clarabelle's New Coop
Episodes.Description: When Clarabelle's coop is wrecked, Mickey and friends rebuild it using Mouseketools, giving her chickens a new, improved home!

Episodes.Title: Goofy's Sock Hunt
Episodes.Description: Goofy's socks vanish during naps, and soon Mickey's stuff goes missing too! They find Pluto gathering items to build a cozy bed for a mama cat and her kittens.

Episodes.Title: Puppy Pluto
Episodes.Description: Professor Von Drake's Itty Bitty Baby Ray turns him and Pluto into babies! Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to reverse the shrink ray.

Episodes.Title: Goofy Pizza
Episodes.Description: Goofy's hungry for pizza, but the fridge is missing ingredients. Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to gather what's needed and make a delicious pizza to share!

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Tune Train
Episodes.Description: Professor Von Drake gifts a calliope car for the Clubhouse Choo-Choo train. Minnie performs a song, and she and Mickey help friends finish chores to join in.

Episodes.Title: Please the Bees
Episodes.Description: Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Dinner Party
Episodes.Description: The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Backpack Adventure
Episodes.Description: Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.

Episodes.Title: Mickey's Mail Mix-Up
Episodes.Description: Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.

Entries.Title: Momentary Lily
Entries.Description: In a lonely city where all the inhabitants have been erased by mysterious machines, Renge encounters a team of girls who have been fighting the machines. She cooks them a meal.

Episodes.Title: Saury Hitsumabushi After the Loneliness
Episodes.Description: In a lonely city where all the inhabitants have been erased by mysterious machines, Renge encounters a team of girls who have been fighting the machines. She cooks them a meal.

Episodes.Title: Canned Mackerel Italian-style Tomato Hot Pot Together
Episodes.Description: Now that Renge has joined the group's ranks with her powerful weapon, Yuri feels capable of confronting the Goliath, a huge machine, and continuing to advance.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Canned Crab and Canned Mackerel Chirashi Sushi
Episodes.Description: With Yuri having passed away, the team must decide what to do next. The photos being posted on social media may offer a clue.

Episodes.Title: Rich and Warm Corn Beef Miso Ramen
Episodes.Description: A sudden snowstorm forces the girls to take refuge in a school.

Episodes.Title: Wishing On Mackerel, Oyster, and Egg Zosui Soup Kuzushi Kiritampo Style
Episodes.Description: The relationship between Erika and Hinageshi becomes strained. A duel between the big sister and the gamer begins.

Episodes.Title: Pool Videos, Summer and Shanghai-style Squid Yakisoba
Episodes.Description: The team makes videos by the pool to prove on social media that they are humans.

Episodes.Title: Fighting Together for Shio Musubi
Episodes.Description: The team fights a large group of Wild Hunt threatening what appears to be Citron's group.

Episodes.Title: Chocolate Bars Once the Rain Stops
Episodes.Description: Renge meets Suzuran and discovers that she may not be who -- or what -- she thinks she is.

Episodes.Title: Laughed All Night and Put Lots of Secret Ingredients in a Surprisingly Tasty Curry
Episodes.Description: Suzuran's group prepares to move to Citron's settlement.

Episodes.Title: One More and a Missing Can
Episodes.Description: The team chase Yuri into a station and discover more than they can wrap their head around.

Episodes.Title: Cooking Together With the Untouchable Girl
Episodes.Description: Hinageshi hacks the facility's AI, forcing it to explain its role.

Episodes.Title: Such A Fun Full-Course Meal

Episodes.Title: Ending on an Ochazuke Buffet with Everyone Around
Episodes.Description: The girls continued their fierce battle in "Everyone's Ochazuke Buffet."

Entries.Title: Medalist
Entries.Description: When former figure skater Tsukasa Akeuraji meets a self-taught skater, Inori Yuitsuka, he tries to persuade her to join a formal ice skating club. Unfortunately, Inori's mother wants her clumsy daughter to give up skating altogether.

Episodes.Title: A Genius on the Ice
Episodes.Description: When former figure skater Tsukasa Akeuraji meets a self-taught skater, Inori Yuitsuka, he tries to persuade her to join a formal ice skating club. Unfortunately, Inori's mother wants her clumsy daughter to give up skating altogether.

Episodes.Title: Prelim Badge Test
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa and Hitomi encourage Inori to take the Badge Test, a certification exam for figure skating which will allow Inori to qualify for competitions. On the day of the test, Inori meets a beautiful girl who looks like a princess.

Episodes.Title: Taiyaki and Cake
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa decides to enter Inori into the Meikoh Cup to build up her record of success. When Inori feels shy dancing in front of others, Tsukasa gets her to dance in his shadow to conquer her nerves. During skating practice, Inori also meets a girl named Miké at the rink.

Episodes.Title: Meikoh Cup, Junior Women's Prelim Free Skating (1)
Episodes.Description: Inori's first competition, the Meikoh cup, begins. Inori's future is at stake, and while she gets off to a rocky start, her mother and sister are there to support her from the sidelines.

Episodes.Title: Meikoh Cup, Junior Women's Prelim Free Skating (2)
Episodes.Description: Inori came in top in the first round of the Prelims, whereas Miké was the last one to secure a spot. Determined to turn things around, Miké decides to try and pull off a double rotation combination that no one at the Prelims has done before.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the First Competition
Episodes.Description: Hikaru is one of the best performers of Inori's generation, and Inori is eager to catch up. However, she worries about how far behind she is in terms of her skill level compared to others her age. Tsukasa suggests Inori compete in a competition immediately after passing the level one badge test.

Episodes.Title: Level One Badge Test
Episodes.Description: Inori faces the level one badge test, setting her next step of competing in a championship. A successful double jump will be essential for a high score.

Episodes.Title: Western Powerhouses (1)
Episodes.Description: On the way to a competition, Inori leaves her skates on a train by accident. Tsukasa goes on a mad hunt for the skates ten stations away.

Episodes.Title: Western Powerhouses (2)
Episodes.Description: After a smooth start, Inori decides to take each jump carefully, one by one. She controls her center of gravity and maintains a high speed, and Tsukasa cannot hide his excitement as she continues with her flawless performance.

Episodes.Title: Howling at Night
Episodes.Description: Inori competes in her second Meikoh cup, but she will need to perfect the extremely difficult double Axel if she is to progress to the next level. Meanwhile, Tsukasa is asked by Olympic silver medalist Shinichiro Sonidori to mentor his son, Rioh.

Episodes.Title: Dance the Night
Episodes.Description: The Lux Higashiyama FSC summer training camp begins, and Inori plans to perfect her double Axel. Meanwhile, Tsukasa offers to help Rioh, but Rioh turns him down.

Episodes.Title: Shirone's Lesson
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa learns of the anguish Rioh has been carrying, and dances Rioh's program on the rink. Rioh is surprised to see that Tsukasa's skating is much more skillful than he expected.

Episodes.Title: Morning Arrives
Episodes.Description: The day of the Level Six Badge Test has finally arrived. The venue is the memorable place where Inori first met Hikaru. When Hikaru suddenly appears, she promises to meet Inori again at the All-Japans.
